INSERT INTO alert_state (strategy, last_signal_id, last_pushover_at, last_email_at, paused, updated_at)
VALUES (sqlc.arg('strategy'), sqlc.arg('last_signal_id'), sqlc.arg('last_pushover_at'), sqlc.arg('last_email_at'), sqlc.arg('paused'), now())

cases.name: stonkpile/SignalDigest
cases.sql:
-- name: SignalDigest :many
SELECT s.symbol, s.direction, COUNT(*) as signal_count,
       ROUND(AVG(s.conviction)::numeric, 2) as avg_conviction,
       ROUND(MAX(s.conviction)::numeric, 2) as max_conviction,
       s.asset_type
FROM signals s
JOIN strategies st ON st.id = s.strategy_id
WHERE s.ts >= sqlc.arg('from')
  AND s.direction IN ('long', 'short')
  AND (sqlc.arg('timeframe')::text = '' OR s.timeframe = sqlc.arg('timeframe'))
  AND (sqlc.arg('asset_type')::text = '' OR s.asset_type = sqlc.arg('asset_type'))
  AND (sqlc.arg('strategy_name')::text = '' OR st.name = sqlc.arg('strategy_name'))
GROUP BY s.symbol, s.direction, s.asset_type
ORDER BY avg_conviction DESC, signal_count DESC;

cases.name: stonkpile/UpsertBar
cases.sql:
-- name: UpsertBar :exec
INSERT INTO bars (symbol, timeframe, ts, open, high, low, close, volume, source, asset_type)
VALUES (sqlc.arg('symbol'), sqlc.arg('timeframe'), sqlc.arg('ts'), sqlc.arg('open'), sqlc.arg('high'), sqlc.arg('low'), sqlc.arg('close'), sqlc.arg('volume'), sqlc.arg('source'), sqlc.arg('asset_type'))
ON CONFLICT (symbol, timeframe, ts) DO UPDATE
SET open      = EXCLUDED.open,
    high      = EXCLUDED.high,
    low       = EXCLUDED.low,
    close     = EXCLUDED.close,
    volume    = EXCLUDED.volume,
    source    = EXCLUDED.source,
    asset_type = EXCLUDED.asset_type
WHERE (bars.open, bars.high, bars.low, bars.close, bars.volume, bars.source, bars.asset_type)
    IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.open, EXCLUDED.high, EXCLUDED.low, EXCLUDED.close, EXCLUDED.volume, EXCLUDED.source, EXCLUDED.asset_type);

cases.name: stonkpile/UpsertBarsBatch
cases.sql:
-- name: UpsertBarsBatch :exec
-- Filter visible identical rows before ON CONFLICT: its WHERE guard prevents
-- tuple rewrites but still waits for row locks, even for an unchanged bar.
WITH incoming AS (
SELECT unnest(sqlc.arg(symbols)::text[]) AS symbol,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(timeframes)::text[]) AS timeframe,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(timestamps)::timestamptz[]) AS ts,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(opens)::double precision[])::numeric AS open,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(highs)::double precision[])::numeric AS high,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(lows)::double precision[])::numeric AS low,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(closes)::double precision[])::numeric AS close,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(volumes)::double precision[])::numeric AS volume,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(sources)::text[]) AS source,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(asset_types)::text[]) AS asset_type
)
INSERT INTO bars (symbol, timeframe, ts, open, high, low, close, volume, source, asset_type)
SELECT i.* FROM incoming i
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bars b
    WHERE b.symbol=i.symbol AND b.timeframe=i.timeframe AND b.ts=i.ts
      AND (b.open,b.high,b.low,b.close,b.volume,b.source,b.asset_type)
          IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (i.open,i.high,i.low,i.close,i.volume,i.source,i.asset_type)
)
ORDER BY i.symbol,i.timeframe,i.ts
ON CONFLICT (symbol, timeframe, ts) DO UPDATE
SET open       = EXCLUDED.open,
    high       = EXCLUDED.high,
    low        = EXCLUDED.low,
    close      = EXCLUDED.close,
    volume     = EXCLUDED.volume,
    source     = EXCLUDED.source,
    asset_type = EXCLUDED.asset_type
WHERE (bars.open, bars.high, bars.low, bars.close, bars.volume, bars.source, bars.asset_type)
    IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.open, EXCLUDED.high, EXCLUDED.low, EXCLUDED.close, EXCLUDED.volume, EXCLUDED.source, EXCLUDED.asset_type);

cases.name: stonkpile/GetBarsColumnarBatch
cases.sql:
-- name: GetBarsColumnarBatch :many
-- Aggregate each bounded series separately; sorting an entire multi-symbol
-- panel can spill despite every individual series fitting in work_mem.
SELECT requested.symbol::text AS symbol, aggregated.*
FROM (SELECT unnest(sqlc.arg(symbols)::text[]) AS symbol,
             unnest(sqlc.arg(froms)::timestamptz[]) AS from_ts) AS requested
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT array_agg(ts ORDER BY ts)::timestamptz[] AS timestamps,
           array_agg(open ORDER BY ts)::float8[] AS opens,
           array_agg(high ORDER BY ts)::float8[] AS highs,
           array_agg(low ORDER BY ts)::float8[] AS lows,
           array_agg(close ORDER BY ts)::float8[] AS closes,
           array_agg(volume ORDER BY ts)::float8[] AS volumes,
           array_agg(source ORDER BY ts)::text[] AS sources,
           array_agg(asset_type ORDER BY ts)::text[] AS asset_types
    FROM (
        SELECT ts, open::float8 AS open, high::float8 AS high,
               low::float8 AS low, close::float8 AS close,
               volume::float8 AS volume, source, asset_type
        FROM bars
        WHERE bars.symbol = requested.symbol
          AND timeframe = sqlc.arg(timeframe)
          AND ts >= requested.from_ts
          AND ts <= sqlc.arg(through)
        ORDER BY ts ASC
        LIMIT sqlc.arg(page_limit)::int
    ) AS recent
    HAVING count(*) > 0
) AS aggregated
ORDER BY requested.symbol;

cases.name: stonkpile/LatestMarketMapBars
cases.sql:
-- name: LatestMarketMapBars :many
-- Returns the two most recent closes and latest volume for every requested
-- symbol. The API uses these rows to calculate the live treemap color and size.
-- Use bounded backward primary-key scans instead of ranking every historical
-- bar for the requested universe. The bars PK is (symbol, timeframe, ts).
SELECT requested.symbol::text AS symbol,
       latest.ts::timestamptz AS bar_at,
       latest.close::float8 AS price,
       coalesce(previous.close::float8, 0)::float8 AS previous,
       latest.volume::float8 AS volume
FROM unnest(sqlc.arg(symbols)::text[]) AS requested(symbol)
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT bars.ts, bars.close, bars.volume
    FROM bars
    WHERE bars.symbol = requested.symbol
      AND bars.timeframe = sqlc.arg(map_timeframe)
    ORDER BY bars.ts DESC
    LIMIT 1
) latest ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT bars.close
    FROM bars
    WHERE bars.symbol = requested.symbol
      AND bars.timeframe = sqlc.arg(map_timeframe)
      AND bars.ts < latest.ts
    ORDER BY bars.ts DESC
    LIMIT 1
) previous ON true;

cases.sql:
-- name: TouchIngestedBarSeries :exec
INSERT INTO bar_series_usage (symbol, timeframe, last_used_at, last_ingested_at)
SELECT DISTINCT symbol, sqlc.arg(timeframe), now(), now()
FROM unnest(sqlc.arg(symbols)::text[]) AS input(symbol)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM bar_series_usage u
    WHERE u.symbol=input.symbol AND u.timeframe=sqlc.arg(timeframe)
      AND u.last_used_at >= now()-interval '5 minutes'
      AND u.last_ingested_at >= now()-interval '5 minutes'
)
ORDER BY symbol
ON CONFLICT (symbol, timeframe) DO UPDATE
SET last_used_at = CASE
        WHEN bar_series_usage.last_used_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' THEN now()
        ELSE bar_series_usage.last_used_at
    END,
    last_ingested_at = now()
WHERE bar_series_usage.last_used_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
   OR bar_series_usage.last_ingested_at IS NULL
   OR bar_series_usage.last_ingested_at < now() - interval '5 minutes';

cases.sql:
-- name: SelectBarExtremesBatch :many
WITH windows AS (
    SELECT ordinality - 1 AS window_index, symbol, from_ts, to_ts
    FROM unnest(sqlc.arg(symbols)::text[])
        WITH ORDINALITY AS symbols(symbol, ordinality)
    JOIN unnest(sqlc.arg(from_times)::timestamptz[])
        WITH ORDINALITY AS froms(from_ts, ordinality) USING (ordinality)
    JOIN unnest(sqlc.arg(to_times)::timestamptz[])
        WITH ORDINALITY AS tos(to_ts, ordinality) USING (ordinality)
)
SELECT w.window_index::integer,
       COALESCE(extremes.low, 0)::float8 AS low,
       COALESCE(extremes.high, 0)::float8 AS high,
       COALESCE(extremes.bar_count, 0)::bigint AS bar_count
FROM windows w
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT MIN(b.low::float8) AS low,
           MAX(b.high::float8) AS high,
           COUNT(b.ts) AS bar_count
    FROM bars b
    WHERE b.symbol = w.symbol
      AND b.timeframe = sqlc.arg(timeframe)
      AND b.ts >= w.from_ts
      AND b.ts <= w.to_ts
) extremes ON true
ORDER BY w.window_index;

WITH eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT u.symbol,u.timeframe FROM bar_series_usage u
 WHERE u.symbol=sqlc.arg(symbol) AND u.timeframe=sqlc.arg(timeframe)
   AND NOT (u.symbol=ANY(sqlc.arg(protected_symbols)::text[]))
   AND u.last_used_at < now()-interval '24 hours'
   AND (u.last_ingested_at IS NULL OR u.last_ingested_at < now()-interval '24 hours')
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_positions p WHERE p.symbol=u.symbol)
 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
), removed AS (
 DELETE FROM bars b USING eligible e WHERE b.symbol=e.symbol AND b.timeframe=e.timeframe RETURNING 1
), usage_removed AS (
 DELETE FROM bar_series_usage u USING eligible e WHERE u.symbol=e.symbol AND u.timeframe=e.timeframe
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM removed)>=0 RETURNING 1
)
SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM removed WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM usage_removed)>=0;

cases.name: stonkpile/EvictIdleBarSeriesBatch
cases.sql:
-- name: EvictIdleBarSeriesBatch :one
WITH eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT u.symbol,u.timeframe FROM bar_series_usage u
 WHERE NOT (u.symbol=ANY(sqlc.arg(protected_symbols)::text[]))
   AND u.last_used_at < now()-interval '24 hours'
   AND (u.last_ingested_at IS NULL OR u.last_ingested_at < now()-interval '24 hours')
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_positions p WHERE p.symbol=u.symbol)
 ORDER BY u.last_used_at, u.symbol, u.timeframe
 LIMIT sqlc.arg(batch_size)::int
 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
), removed AS (
 DELETE FROM bars b USING eligible e WHERE b.symbol=e.symbol AND b.timeframe=e.timeframe RETURNING 1
), usage_removed AS (
 DELETE FROM bar_series_usage u USING eligible e WHERE u.symbol=e.symbol AND u.timeframe=e.timeframe
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM removed)>=0 RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*)::bigint FROM removed) AS rows,
       (SELECT count(*)::int FROM usage_removed) AS series;

cases.name: stonkpile/ClaimPendingMarketEventOccurrences

-- name: ClaimPendingMarketEventOccurrences :many
WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM market_event_occurrences
    WHERE sent_at IS NULL
      AND rule_id = ANY(sqlc.arg(rule_ids)::text[])
      AND (
          delivery_claimed_at IS NULL OR
          delivery_claimed_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
      )
    ORDER BY observed_at, id
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT sqlc.arg(limit_count)
)
UPDATE market_event_occurrences AS occurrence
SET delivery_claim_id = sqlc.arg(claim_id),
    delivery_claimed_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
FROM candidates
WHERE occurrence.id = candidates.id
RETURNING occurrence.id, occurrence.rule_id, occurrence.rule_name,
          occurrence.trigger_id, occurrence.trigger_label, occurrence.symbol,
          occurrence.metric_type, occurrence.timeframe, occurrence.observed_at,
          occurrence.previous_value, occurrence.current_value, occurrence.threshold_value,

    config_hash, asset_class, timeframe, direction,
    strategy_params, execution_profile, management_policy, strategy_execution_policies, universe

-- name: ListOptimizerCandidateResults :many
-- Dashboard and selection callers do not need the persisted full-resolution
-- candidate curve. The leading dashboard curves are rebuilt from fold rows and
-- downsampled separately; returning [] here avoids pulling every candidate's
-- potentially multi-megabyte JSONB curve through Postgres and Go.
SELECT
    r.run_id, r.configuration_id, r.rank, r.stage, r.eligible, r.score,
    r.realized_return, r.marked_return, r.total_r, r.r_per_day,
    r.profit_per_trade, r.max_drawdown, r.max_drawdown_dollars, r.peak_locked_pct,
    r.positive_fold_pct, r.trades, r.fees, r.metrics,

    r.paired_utility, r.paired_fold_win_pct, r.evolutionary_success,
    r.center_configuration_id, r.sharpe,
    r.representative_strategy_id, r.strategy_rank_snapshot_id,
    representative_strategy.name AS representative_strategy,
    c.config_hash, c.strategy_params, c.execution_profile, c.management_policy,
    c.strategy_execution_policies,
    p.parent_configuration_id, p.generation, p.proposal_kind,
    p.mutation_vector, p.normalized_distance, p.changed_parameters
FROM optimizer_candidate_results r
JOIN tradebot_configurations c ON c.id = r.configuration_id
LEFT JOIN strategies representative_strategy ON representative_strategy.id = r.representative_strategy_id
LEFT JOIN optimizer_candidate_proposals p
  ON p.run_id = r.run_id AND p.configuration_id = r.configuration_id

cases.name: stonkpile/ListParitySnapshotsForCycle

-- name: ListParitySnapshotsForCycle :many
SELECT s.snapshot_id FROM tradebot_parity_snapshots s
JOIN tradebot_cycle_receipts r ON r.account_id=s.account_id AND r.broker=s.broker
 AND r.asset_class=s.asset_class AND r.timeframe=s.timeframe AND r.watermark=s.watermark
WHERE r.receipt_id=sqlc.arg(receipt_id)
 AND (
 EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_cycle_phases p WHERE p.receipt_id=r.receipt_id
   AND p.phase='entry_boundary' AND p.evidence->>'snapshotId'=s.snapshot_id)
 OR (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_cycle_phases p WHERE p.receipt_id=r.receipt_id AND p.phase='entry_boundary')
   AND r.phase NOT IN ('market_gate','management_price_gate')
   AND s.created_at>=r.started_at AND s.created_at<=r.finished_at)
 )

 ((r.phase='market_gate' AND r.result->>'message'='market closed') OR r.phase='management_price_gate') AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_parity_coverage_sessions s WHERE s.account_id=r.account_id AND s.broker=r.broker
 AND s.asset_class=r.asset_class AND s.timeframe=r.timeframe AND r.watermark>=s.session_open AND r.watermark<s.session_close
))) AND r.finished_at IS NOT NULL
 AND a.receipt_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_parity_coverage_scopes c WHERE c.account_id=r.account_id AND c.broker=r.broker
 AND c.asset_class=r.asset_class AND c.timeframe=r.timeframe AND r.started_at>=c.monitored_from

cases.name: stonkpile/ListPendingParityBoundaryAudits
cases.sql:
-- name: ListPendingParityBoundaryAudits :many
-- Rank fresh evidence and revision rechecks independently within each account session.
-- A busy fresh stream must not leave corrected historical verdicts starved.
WITH pending AS (
SELECT s.snapshot_id,s.watermark,a.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL AS is_recheck,
 row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY s.account_id,s.broker,s.asset_class,s.timeframe,c.session_open,(a.snapshot_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY s.watermark,s.snapshot_id) AS scope_rank
FROM tradebot_parity_snapshots s
JOIN tradebot_parity_coverage_sessions c ON c.account_id=s.account_id AND c.broker=s.broker
 AND c.asset_class=s.asset_class AND c.timeframe=s.timeframe
 AND s.watermark>=c.session_open AND s.watermark<c.session_close
LEFT JOIN tradebot_parity_boundary_audits a USING(snapshot_id)
WHERE (a.snapshot_id IS NULL OR (
 a.result->>'status' IN ('unmatched','unverifiable')
 AND COALESCE(a.result->>'revision','') <> sqlc.arg(engine_revision)::text
)) AND EXISTS (
 SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_cycle_receipts r WHERE r.account_id=s.account_id AND r.broker=s.broker
 AND r.asset_class=s.asset_class AND r.timeframe=s.timeframe AND r.watermark=s.watermark
 AND r.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND r.error=''
)
)
SELECT snapshot_id FROM pending ORDER BY scope_rank,is_recheck,watermark,snapshot_id LIMIT sqlc.arg(batch_limit);

cases.name: stonkpile/RequeueLongNativeProtectionQuotes
cases.sql:
-- name: RequeueLongNativeProtectionQuotes :execrows
-- The former daily-window guard skipped the provider entirely for long-lived
-- native GTC orders. Recover only those terminal absence-of-coverage verdicts.
UPDATE tradebot_parity_verification_jobs j
SET payload=j.payload || jsonb_build_object('supersededLongProtectionQuoteVerdict',j.result,
      'verificationRetryBase',j.attempts),
    state='queued',result=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=now(),updated_at=now()
FROM tradebot_parity_protection_captures c
WHERE j.state='completed' AND j.payload->'Trade'->>'Close'='true'
  AND c.capture_id=j.payload->'ExitInputs'->'ProtectionFill'->>'CaptureID'
  AND c.broker_order_id=j.payload->>'BrokerOrderID'
  AND j.payload->>'AssetClass'='crypto'
  AND j.result->>'status'='unverifiable'
  AND j.result->>'explanation'='complete compatible native stop quote history is unavailable'
  AND j.result->>'reportId' LIKE 'protection-execution:%'
  AND (j.payload->'Trade'->>'ExitAt')::timestamptz -
      greatest((j.payload->'ExitInputs'->'ProtectionContract'->>'CapturedAt')::timestamptz,
        NULLIF(c.bound_order->>'submitted_at','')::timestamptz) > interval '26 hours'
  AND NOT j.payload ? 'supersededLongProtectionQuoteVerdict';

cases.name: stonkpile/RequeueLegacyProtectionTimingComparisons
cases.sql:
-- name: RequeueLegacyProtectionTimingComparisons :execrows
-- The legacy native-stop comparator discarded the shared matcher's bounded-
-- late result. Recheck that specific contradiction once, preserving its receipt.
-- Economic mismatches and active leases are not eligible; only a real replay
-- may publish a replacement verdict.
UPDATE tradebot_parity_verification_jobs j
SET payload=j.payload || jsonb_build_object('supersededProtectionTimingVerdict',j.result,
      'verificationRetryBase',j.attempts),
    state='queued',result=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=now(),updated_at=now()
WHERE j.state='completed' AND j.payload->'Trade'->>'Close'='true'
  AND j.result->>'status'='unmatched'
  AND j.result->>'reportId' LIKE 'protection-execution:%'
  AND j.result->>'explanation' LIKE 'sealed management policy and native stop-limit order verified;%replay trade matched with bounded-late broker fill%'
  AND NOT j.payload ? 'supersededProtectionTimingVerdict';

cases.name: stonkpile/ResumeClosingSessionTailWaits
cases.sql:
-- name: ResumeClosingSessionTailWaits :execrows
-- Apply the calendar-bound replay repair once, without stealing a lease or
-- reopening an expired missing-bar verdict / seven-day recovery episode.
UPDATE tradebot_parity_verification_jobs
SET next_attempt_at=now(),updated_at=now(),payload=payload || jsonb_build_object(
 'closingSessionBoundsRecovery',jsonb_build_object('error',last_error,'previousNextAttempt',next_attempt_at))
WHERE state='retry' AND result IS NULL AND payload->>'AssetClass'='equity'
 AND payload->>'Timeframe'<>'1d' AND payload->'Trade'->>'Close'='true'
 AND last_error LIKE 'waiting for closing replay to execute through %; shared replay tail remains incomplete;%'
 AND NOT payload ? 'closingSessionBoundsRecovery' AND NOT payload ? 'missingBarTimeout';

cases.sql:
-- name: DeferParityDatabaseTimeout :execrows
UPDATE tradebot_parity_verification_jobs
SET state='retry',last_error=sqlc.arg(last_error),
    payload=payload || jsonb_build_object('databaseTimeoutRecovery',
      jsonb_build_object('error',sqlc.arg(last_error)::text,'at',now()),
      'verificationRetryBase',attempts),
    lease_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=now()+interval '1 minute',updated_at=now()
WHERE job_key=sqlc.arg(job_key) AND state='running'
  AND attempts=sqlc.arg(attempts) AND verification_class='current'
  AND NOT payload ? 'databaseTimeoutRecovery';

cases.name: stonkpile/RequeueExhaustedParityDatabaseTimeouts
cases.sql:
-- name: RequeueExhaustedParityDatabaseTimeouts :execrows
-- One recovery per pinned job. Never take a running lease, retry a mismatch,
-- or remove its old terminal verdict from retained provenance.
UPDATE tradebot_parity_verification_jobs
SET state='queued',payload=payload || jsonb_build_object(
      'databaseTimeoutRecovery',jsonb_build_object('result',result,'at',now()),
      'verificationRetryBase',attempts),
    result=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=now(),updated_at=now()
WHERE state='completed' AND result->>'status'='unverifiable'
  AND result->>'explanation' ~ '^verification failed after [0-9]+ attempts: .*canceling statement due to statement timeout.*SQLSTATE 57014'
  AND NOT payload ? 'databaseTimeoutRecovery';

cases.name: stonkpile/RequeueMissingClosingBars
cases.sql:
-- name: RequeueMissingClosingBars :execrows
-- Legacy workers exhausted the ordinary error budget on unpublished bars.
-- Retain that exact receipt; never requeue economic mismatches or steal leases.
UPDATE tradebot_parity_verification_jobs j
SET payload=j.payload || jsonb_build_object('supersededMissingBarVerdict',
      j.result,'verificationRetryBase',j.attempts),
    state='queued',result=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=now(),updated_at=now()
WHERE j.state='completed' AND j.payload->'Trade'->>'Close'='true'
  AND j.result->>'status'='unverifiable'
  AND j.result->>'explanation' ~ '^verification failed after [0-9]+ attempts: waiting for closing (execution bar |replay to execute through )'
  AND NOT j.payload ? 'supersededMissingBarVerdict';

cases.name: stonkpile/RequeueHistoricalClosingWindows
cases.sql:
-- name: RequeueHistoricalClosingWindows :execrows
-- Recover obsolete terminal closing windows across rolling upgrades. Running
-- leases remain owned, and attempts remain monotonic to fence old workers.
UPDATE tradebot_parity_verification_jobs j
SET payload=j.payload || jsonb_build_object('supersededHistoricalWindowVerdict',
      COALESCE(j.payload->'supersededHistoricalWindowVerdict',j.result),'verificationRetryBase',j.attempts),
    state='queued', result=NULL, lease_until=NULL,
    next_attempt_at=now(), updated_at=now()
WHERE j.state='completed' AND j.payload->'Trade'->>'Close'='true'
  AND j.result->>'status'='unmatched'
  AND COALESCE((j.result->>'engineVersion')::integer,0)<sqlc.arg(minimum_engine_version)::integer
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_parity_replay_batches r WHERE r.batch_id=j.result->>'reportId');

cases.name: stonkpile/ResumeMissingBarIngestionRecovery
cases.sql:
-- name: ResumeMissingBarIngestionRecovery :execrows
-- When the recovery client becomes available, do not wait out a deadline set
-- while it was unavailable. Never replace an active lease or a provider cooldown.
UPDATE tradebot_parity_verification_jobs
SET next_attempt_at=now(),updated_at=now(),
    payload=payload || jsonb_build_object('resumedMissingBarRecovery',
      jsonb_build_object('previousError',last_error,'previousNextAttempt',next_attempt_at))
WHERE state='retry' AND next_attempt_at>now() AND payload->'Trade'->>'Close'='true'
  AND last_error LIKE 'waiting for closing execution bar %; ingestion workflow inspection unavailable%'
  AND NOT payload ? 'resumedMissingBarRecovery';

cases.name: stonkpile/RequeueLegacyMarketTargetComparisons
cases.sql:
-- name: RequeueLegacyMarketTargetComparisons :execrows
-- Retry only obsolete failed crypto target comparisons. Bind the newly exposed
-- exit reference to the retained submitted intent, never the observed fill.
UPDATE tradebot_parity_verification_jobs j
SET payload=j.payload || jsonb_build_object('supersededMarketTargetVerdict',
      COALESCE(j.payload->'supersededMarketTargetVerdict',j.result),
      'verificationRetryBase',j.attempts,'ExitReferencePrice',i.reference_price),
    state='queued',result=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=now(),updated_at=now()
FROM tradebot_parity_replay_batches r, tradebot_intents i
WHERE j.state='completed' AND j.payload->'Trade'->>'Close'='true'
  AND j.result->>'status'='unmatched' AND r.batch_id=j.result->>'reportId'
  AND COALESCE((r.replay->>'executionComparisonVersion')::integer,0)=0
  AND j.payload->>'AssetClass'='crypto' AND j.payload->>'Reason'='target'
  AND i.intent_id=j.intent_id AND i.asset_class='crypto' AND i.reason='target'
  AND i.action IN ('close_long','close_short','cover_short') AND i.reference_price>0;

cases.name: stonkpile/RequeueMissingTimeframeClosingAnchors
cases.sql:
-- name: RequeueMissingTimeframeClosingAnchors :execrows
-- Retry the old fixed-fifteen-minute lookup failure once. Preserve the receipt
-- and attempt generation; never reopen matches/mismatches or take a lease.
UPDATE tradebot_parity_verification_jobs
SET state='queued',payload=payload || jsonb_build_object(
 'closingAnchorScopeRecovery',jsonb_build_object('result',result,'at',now()),
 'verificationRetryBase',attempts),
 result=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=now(),updated_at=now()
WHERE state='completed' AND payload->'Trade'->>'Close'='true'
 AND payload->>'Timeframe' IN ('15m','30m','1h','1d')
 AND result->>'status'='unverifiable'
 AND result->>'explanation' ~ '^verification failed after [0-9]+ attempts: load pre-exit account batch boundary: no rows in result set$'
 AND NOT payload ? 'closingAnchorScopeRecovery';

cases.name: stonkpile/ClaimParityVerificationJobs
cases.sql:
-- name: ClaimParityVerificationJobs :many
WITH next_batch AS (
 SELECT payload,verification_class FROM tradebot_parity_verification_jobs
 WHERE (state IN ('queued','retry') AND next_attempt_at<=now()) OR (state='running' AND lease_until<=now())
 ORDER BY priority + CASE WHEN verification_class='historical' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END,
 CASE WHEN verification_class='historical' THEN created_at END DESC,created_at,job_key FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
), ready AS (
 SELECT j.job_key FROM tradebot_parity_verification_jobs j CROSS JOIN next_batch b
 WHERE ((j.state IN ('queued','retry') AND j.next_attempt_at<=now()) OR (j.state='running' AND j.lease_until<=now()))
 AND j.verification_class=b.verification_class
 AND COALESCE(j.payload->'Trade'->>'Close','false')=COALESCE(b.payload->'Trade'->>'Close','false')
 AND CASE WHEN j.payload->'Trade'->>'Close'='true' THEN
   j.payload->>'AssetClass'=b.payload->>'AssetClass' AND j.payload->>'Timeframe'=b.payload->>'Timeframe'
   AND left(j.payload->'Trade'->>'ExitAt',10)=left(b.payload->'Trade'->>'ExitAt',10)
 ELSE COALESCE(j.payload->>'SnapshotID','')=COALESCE(b.payload->>'SnapshotID','') END
 ORDER BY j.priority + CASE WHEN j.verification_class='historical' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END,
 CASE WHEN j.verification_class='historical' THEN j.created_at END DESC,j.created_at,j.job_key FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED LIMIT sqlc.arg(batch_limit)
)
UPDATE tradebot_parity_verification_jobs j SET state='running',attempts=attempts+1,
 lease_until=now()+CASE WHEN j.verification_class='current' THEN interval '4 minutes' ELSE interval '20 minutes' END,updated_at=now()
FROM ready WHERE j.job_key=ready.job_key RETURNING j.*;

cases.name: stonkpile/ClaimCurrentParityVerificationJobs
cases.sql:
-- name: ClaimCurrentParityVerificationJobs :many
-- Current trades across every asset class and timeframe have a latency contract
-- distinct from cold historical closing-window replays. This claim can be
-- served by a dedicated worker without consuming that slot with archive work.
WITH next_batch AS (
 SELECT payload FROM tradebot_parity_verification_jobs
 WHERE ((state IN ('queued','retry') AND next_attempt_at<=now()) OR
   (state='running' AND (lease_until<=now() OR updated_at<=now()-interval '4 minutes')))
   AND verification_class='current'
 ORDER BY priority,created_at,job_key FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
), ready AS (
 SELECT j.job_key FROM tradebot_parity_verification_jobs j CROSS JOIN next_batch b
 WHERE ((j.state IN ('queued','retry') AND j.next_attempt_at<=now()) OR
   (j.state='running' AND (j.lease_until<=now() OR j.updated_at<=now()-interval '4 minutes')))
   AND j.verification_class='current'
   AND COALESCE(j.payload->'Trade'->>'Close','false')=COALESCE(b.payload->'Trade'->>'Close','false')
   AND CASE WHEN j.payload->'Trade'->>'Close'='true' THEN
     j.payload->>'AssetClass'=b.payload->>'AssetClass' AND j.payload->>'Timeframe'=b.payload->>'Timeframe'
     AND left(j.payload->'Trade'->>'ExitAt',10)=left(b.payload->'Trade'->>'ExitAt',10)
   ELSE COALESCE(j.payload->>'SnapshotID','')=COALESCE(b.payload->>'SnapshotID','') END
 ORDER BY j.priority,j.created_at,j.job_key FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED LIMIT sqlc.arg(batch_limit)
)
UPDATE tradebot_parity_verification_jobs j SET state='running',attempts=attempts+1,
 lease_until=now()+interval '4 minutes',updated_at=now()
FROM ready WHERE j.job_key=ready.job_key RETURNING j.*;

cases.name: stonkpile/CompleteParityVerificationJob
cases.sql:
-- name: CompleteParityVerificationJob :exec
UPDATE tradebot_parity_verification_jobs SET state='completed',result=sqlc.arg(result)::jsonb,

cases.name: stonkpile/ListLatestFailedPortfolioResearchRuns
cases.sql:
-- name: ListLatestFailedPortfolioResearchRuns :many
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT id, timeframe, research_mode, status, created_at, completed_at, error_message,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY timeframe ORDER BY id DESC) AS timeframe_rank
    FROM portfolio_research_runs
    WHERE status IN ('failed', 'completed', 'running')
), latest AS (
    SELECT id, timeframe, research_mode, status, created_at, completed_at, error_message
    FROM ranked
    WHERE timeframe_rank = 1
)
SELECT id, timeframe, research_mode, created_at, completed_at, error_message
FROM latest
WHERE status = 'failed'
  AND completed_at IS NOT NULL
  -- Worker shutdowns and activity timeouts are expected handoff signals, not
  -- evidence of a broken research lane. Temporal retries or the next schedule
  -- run must get a chance before health reports a real failure.
  AND error_message NOT ILIKE '%context canceled%'
  AND error_message NOT ILIKE '%context deadline exceeded%'
  -- Require sustained failure across three consecutive attempts for this
  -- timeframe. A newer running or completed row naturally suppresses this.
  AND (
      SELECT count(*)
      FROM ranked recent
      WHERE recent.timeframe = latest.timeframe
        AND recent.timeframe_rank <= 3
        AND recent.status = 'failed'
        AND recent.error_message NOT ILIKE '%context canceled%'
        AND recent.error_message NOT ILIKE '%context deadline exceeded%'
  ) = 3
ORDER BY timeframe;

cases.name: stonkpile/ListDynamicPortfolioRevisionCandidates
cases.sql:
-- name: ListDynamicPortfolioRevisionCandidates :many
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT pr.id AS run_id, pr.timeframe, pr.from_ts AS evidence_from,
           pr.to_ts AS evidence_to, pr.decision_at,
           c.id AS context_id, c.trade_symbols, c.signal_context_symbols,
           c.fingerprint, r.forward_score, r.score,
           coverage.window_count, coverage.covered_days,
           row_number() OVER (
               PARTITION BY pr.id
               ORDER BY r.forward_score DESC, r.score DESC,
                        r.forced_liquidation_final_equity DESC, c.fingerprint
           ) AS run_rank
    FROM portfolio_research_runs pr
    JOIN portfolio_contexts c ON c.run_id = pr.id
    JOIN portfolio_context_results r ON r.context_id = c.id
    JOIN (
        SELECT context_id, COUNT(*)::int AS window_count,
               EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(to_ts) - MIN(from_ts))) / 86400.0 AS covered_days
        FROM portfolio_context_window_results
        GROUP BY context_id
    ) coverage ON coverage.context_id = c.id
    WHERE pr.status = 'completed'
      AND pr.timeframe = sqlc.arg('timeframe')
      AND pr.to_ts <= pr.decision_at
      -- Paired contexts are complete fixed-size portfolios, not merely
      -- marginal rows. They must be eligible for timeline promotion when
      -- their own whole-portfolio robustness result passes the gates below.
      AND r.forced_liquidation_final_equity > 100000
      AND r.max_dd_pct <= 20
      AND r.windows > 0
      AND r.profitable_windows * 5 >= r.windows * 3
      -- A portfolio must have several persisted chronological windows spanning
      -- most of its research interval; one concentrated winning segment is not
      -- sufficient evidence for a dated DP decision.
      AND coverage.window_count >= CASE pr.timeframe
          WHEN '1m' THEN 3
          WHEN '5m' THEN 4
          WHEN '1h' THEN 6
          WHEN '1d' THEN 8
          ELSE 3
      END
      AND coverage.covered_days >= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pr.to_ts - pr.from_ts)) / 86400.0 * 0.75
), best_per_decision AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (decision_at)
           run_id, timeframe, evidence_from, evidence_to, decision_at,
           context_id, trade_symbols, signal_context_symbols, fingerprint,
           forward_score, score
    FROM ranked
    WHERE run_rank = 1
    ORDER BY decision_at, forward_score DESC, score DESC, run_id DESC
)
SELECT *
FROM best_per_decision
ORDER BY decision_at, run_id;

cases.name: stonkpile/ActivateDynamicPortfolioRevision
cases.sql:
-- name: ActivateDynamicPortfolioRevision :exec
WITH candidate AS (
    SELECT revision.id, revision.timeframe, revision.created_at
    FROM dynamic_portfolio_revisions revision
    WHERE revision.id = sqlc.arg(revision_id) AND revision.status = 'pending'
)
UPDATE dynamic_portfolio_revisions revision
SET status = CASE
    WHEN revision.id = candidate.id THEN 'active'
    ELSE 'superseded'
END
FROM candidate
WHERE revision.timeframe = candidate.timeframe
  AND (
      revision.id = candidate.id OR
      (revision.status IN ('active', 'pending') AND revision.created_at <= candidate.created_at)
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM dynamic_portfolio_revisions newer
      WHERE newer.timeframe = candidate.timeframe
        AND newer.status = 'active'
        AND newer.created_at > candidate.created_at
  );

-- name: ListDynamicPortfolioV5Symbols :many
WITH marginal AS (
    SELECT symbol,
           COUNT(*)::bigint AS samples,
           AVG(delta_score)::double precision AS mean_delta_score,
           percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delta_score)::double precision
               AS median_delta_score,
           percentile_cont(0.2) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY delta_score)::double precision
               AS p20_delta_score,
           AVG((delta_score > 0)::int)::double precision AS positive_rate,
           stddev_pop(delta_score)::double precision AS score_dispersion,
           AVG(delta_forced_equity)::double precision AS mean_delta_forced_equity
    FROM portfolio_paired_marginals
    WHERE run_id = (
        SELECT run_id FROM portfolio_contexts WHERE id = sqlc.arg('contextID')
    )
    GROUP BY symbol
)
SELECT s.context_id, s.ticker, COALESCE(t.title, '')::text AS company_name,
       s.trades, s.wins, s.losses, s.win_rate, s.realized_pnl,
       s.unrealized_pnl, s.total_r, s.avg_r,
       COALESCE(m.samples, 0)::bigint AS marginal_samples,
       COALESCE(m.mean_delta_score, 0)::double precision AS mean_delta_score,
       COALESCE(m.median_delta_score, 0)::double precision AS median_delta_score,
       COALESCE(m.p20_delta_score, 0)::double precision AS p20_delta_score,
       COALESCE(m.positive_rate, 0)::double precision AS positive_rate,
       COALESCE(m.score_dispersion, 0)::double precision AS score_dispersion,
       COALESCE(m.mean_delta_forced_equity, 0)::double precision
           AS mean_delta_forced_equity
FROM portfolio_symbol_results s
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT title
    FROM sec_tickers
    WHERE ticker = s.ticker
    ORDER BY fetched_at DESC, cik
    LIMIT 1
) t ON true
LEFT JOIN marginal m ON m.symbol = s.ticker
WHERE s.context_id = sqlc.arg('contextID')
ORDER BY s.realized_pnl DESC, s.total_r DESC, s.ticker;

cases.sql:
-- name: NetworkScoresForFilledPortfolioPeriods :many
WITH fill_period AS (
    SELECT f.symbol, f.filled_at, period.period_id, period.context_id, period.evidence_to
    FROM (SELECT unnest(sqlc.arg(symbols)::text[]) AS symbol,
                 unnest(sqlc.arg(filled_ats)::timestamptz[]) AS filled_at) AS f
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT p.id AS period_id, p.context_id, p.evidence_to
        FROM dynamic_portfolio_revision_periods p
        JOIN dynamic_portfolio_revisions revision ON revision.id = p.revision_id
        WHERE revision.timeframe = sqlc.arg(timeframe)
          AND p.effective_from <= f.filled_at
          AND (p.effective_to IS NULL OR p.effective_to > f.filled_at)
        ORDER BY p.effective_from DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 1
    ) period ON true
), known_periods AS (
    SELECT symbol, COUNT(DISTINCT period_id) AS period_count, BOOL_AND(period_id IS NOT NULL) AS fully_known
    FROM fill_period GROUP BY symbol
), scored_period AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.symbol) f.symbol, r.network_score
    FROM fill_period f
    JOIN known_periods known ON known.symbol = f.symbol AND known.period_count = 1 AND known.fully_known
    JOIN ticker_backtest_results r ON r.ticker = f.symbol AND r.to_date <= f.evidence_to::date
    JOIN ticker_backtest_contexts ticker_context ON ticker_context.id = r.portfolio_context_id
    JOIN portfolio_contexts portfolio_context ON portfolio_context.id = f.context_id
      AND ticker_context.trade_symbols = portfolio_context.trade_symbols
      AND ticker_context.signal_context_symbols = portfolio_context.signal_context_symbols
    WHERE r.strategy LIKE sqlc.arg(strategy_pattern) AND r.strategy NOT LIKE '%_3m_now'
      AND r.timeframe = sqlc.arg(timeframe)
    ORDER BY f.symbol, r.to_date DESC, r.from_date DESC, r.id DESC
)
SELECT symbol::text AS symbol, network_score::float8 AS network_score FROM scored_period;

cases.name: stonkpile/WatchlistPortfolioRows
cases.sql:
-- name: WatchlistPortfolioRows :many
WITH scoped AS (
    SELECT r.* FROM ticker_backtest_results r
    WHERE r.ticker = ANY(sqlc.arg(tickers)::text[]) AND r.timeframe = sqlc.arg(timeframe)
      AND r.from_date >= sqlc.arg(from_date)::date AND r.to_date <= sqlc.arg(to_date)::date AND r.trades >= 5
      AND r.generation = (SELECT generation FROM ticker_backtest_results GROUP BY generation ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, generation DESC LIMIT 1)
), latest AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.ticker) r.* FROM scoped r
    ORDER BY r.ticker, r.to_date DESC, r.from_date DESC, r.generation DESC, r.id DESC
), regime AS (
    SELECT r.ticker,
      SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct > 0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS bull_r,
      SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < -0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS bear_r,
      SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct BETWEEN -0.05 AND 0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::float8 AS chop_r
    FROM scoped r GROUP BY r.ticker
)
SELECT r.ticker, COALESCE(s.title, '')::text AS company,
 r.total_r::float8, r.win_rate::float8, r.sharpe::float8, r.max_dd_pct::float8,
 r.final_equity::float8, r.trades::float8, r.momentum_ema::float8, r.momentum_ratio::float8,
 r.soxx_20d_pct::float8, r.vixy_20d_pct::float8, r.from_date, r.to_date,
 r.unrealized_pnl::float8, r.expect_r::float8, r.semi_affinity_score, r.semi_affinity_events,
 r.semi_affinity_smh_rate, r.semi_affinity_soxx_rate, r.semi_affinity_soxq_rate,
 r.semi_affinity_xsd_rate, r.semi_affinity_psi_rate, r.semi_affinity_ftxl_rate,
 r.semi_leadership_trend_pct, g.bull_r, g.bear_r, g.chop_r
FROM latest r JOIN regime g USING (ticker) LEFT JOIN sec_tickers s ON s.ticker = r.ticker ORDER BY r.ticker;

cases.name: stonkpile/SelectPortfolioSearchCandidates
cases.sql:
-- name: SelectPortfolioSearchCandidates :many
WITH selected_generation AS (
    SELECT generation
    FROM ticker_backtest_results AS results
    WHERE results.timeframe = sqlc.arg(timeframe)
      AND results.strategy LIKE 'strategy_confluence%'
    GROUP BY generation
    HAVING MAX(to_date) <= sqlc.arg(as_of)::date
    ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT ticker) >= 2 AND COUNT(*) >= 4) DESC,
             generation DESC, COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
), evidence AS (
    SELECT ticker,
           (COALESCE(SUM(network_net_r), 0) +
            GREATEST(SUM(total_r), 0) +
            LN(1 + SUM(trades)))::double precision AS score
    FROM ticker_backtest_results AS results
    WHERE results.generation = (SELECT generation FROM selected_generation)
      AND results.strategy LIKE 'strategy_confluence%'
      AND timeframe = sqlc.arg(timeframe)
    GROUP BY ticker
    UNION ALL
    SELECT f.ticker, MAX(f.forward_score)::double precision AS score
    FROM portfolio_symbol_forecasts f
    JOIN portfolio_research_runs pr ON pr.id = f.run_id
    WHERE pr.status = 'completed'
      AND pr.timeframe = sqlc.arg(timeframe)
      AND pr.to_ts <= sqlc.arg(as_of)
      AND f.forward_score > 0
    GROUP BY f.ticker
)
SELECT ticker
FROM evidence
GROUP BY ticker
ORDER BY MAX(score) DESC, ticker
LIMIT sqlc.arg(result_limit);

cases.name: stonkpile/PruneStaleUnreferencedSignals
cases.sql:
-- name: PruneStaleUnreferencedSignals :execrows
WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s.id
    FROM signals s
    LEFT JOIN signal_contracts sc
      ON sc.strategy_id = s.strategy_id
     AND sc.asset_type = s.asset_type
     AND sc.timeframe = s.timeframe
     AND sc.portfolio_hash = s.portfolio_hash
     AND sc.strategy_config_hash = s.strategy_config_hash
     AND sc.evaluation_version = s.strategy_evaluation_version
    WHERE (
         s.ts < sqlc.arg(cutoff)
       OR s.strategy_evaluation_version <> sqlc.arg(current_evaluation_version)
       OR NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM signal_contracts active_contract
           JOIN signal_coverage active_coverage
             ON active_coverage.contract_id = active_contract.id
           WHERE active_contract.strategy_id = s.strategy_id
             AND active_contract.asset_type = s.asset_type
             AND active_contract.timeframe = s.timeframe
             AND active_contract.portfolio_hash = s.portfolio_hash
             AND active_contract.strategy_config_hash = s.strategy_config_hash
             AND active_contract.evaluation_version = s.strategy_evaluation_version
             AND (active_coverage.status IN ('running', 'complete')
               OR active_coverage.last_error = 'signal cache evicted under storage budget')
       )
       OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM signal_contracts newer_contract
           JOIN signal_coverage newer_coverage
             ON newer_coverage.contract_id = newer_contract.id
           WHERE sc.id IS NOT NULL
             AND newer_contract.strategy_id = sc.strategy_id
             AND newer_contract.asset_type = sc.asset_type
             AND newer_contract.timeframe = sc.timeframe
             AND newer_contract.evaluation_version = sc.evaluation_version
             AND newer_contract.signal_schema_version = sc.signal_schema_version
             AND newer_contract.created_at > sc.created_at
             AND newer_coverage.status = 'complete'
       )
    )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_intents i WHERE i.signal_id = s.id OFFSET 0
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_positions p
          WHERE p.entry_signal_id = s.id OR p.last_signal_id = s.id
          OFFSET 0
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_inventory_states tis
          WHERE tis.last_signal_id = s.id OFFSET 0
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM signal_notes n WHERE n.signal_id = s.id OFFSET 0
      )
      -- signal_outcomes and signal_outcome_features are derived from the
      -- signal and have ON DELETE CASCADE. They must not keep stale signal
      -- versions alive indefinitely; current/trade-referenced lineage is
      -- retained by the contract and trade/position predicates above.
    ORDER BY s.strategy_evaluation_version ASC, s.id ASC
    LIMIT sqlc.arg(batch_size)
    FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED
)
,
deleted_outcome_features AS (
    DELETE FROM signal_outcome_features f
    WHERE f.signal_id IN (SELECT id FROM candidates)
    RETURNING f.signal_id
),
deleted_outcomes AS (
    DELETE FROM signal_outcomes o
    WHERE o.signal_id IN (SELECT id FROM candidates)
    RETURNING o.signal_id
)
DELETE FROM signals s
USING candidates c
WHERE s.id = c.id
  -- Reference both derived-table deletes so the parent delete cannot race
  -- their FK cascades. The scalar counts are always nonnegative, including
  -- an empty derived table, and keep this one transaction set-based.
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_outcome_features) >= 0
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_outcomes) >= 0;

cases.name: stonkpile/PruneLegacyUnreferencedSignals
cases.sql:
-- name: PruneLegacyUnreferencedSignals :execrows
WITH candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s.id
    FROM signals s
    -- Evaluation versions are monotonic and the current version is the
    -- highest version accepted by this binary. Keep the predicate a strict
    -- range so signals_evaluation_version_idx can seek directly to legacy
    -- rows; <> forces a scan of every current-version row first.
    WHERE s.strategy_evaluation_version < sqlc.arg(current_evaluation_version)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_intents i WHERE i.signal_id = s.id OFFSET 0)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_positions p
          WHERE p.entry_signal_id = s.id OR p.last_signal_id = s.id
          OFFSET 0
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_inventory_states tis
          WHERE tis.last_signal_id = s.id OFFSET 0
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM signal_notes n WHERE n.signal_id = s.id OFFSET 0)
    ORDER BY s.strategy_evaluation_version ASC, s.id ASC
    LIMIT sqlc.arg(batch_size)
    FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED
)
,
deleted_outcome_features AS (
    DELETE FROM signal_outcome_features f
    WHERE f.signal_id IN (SELECT id FROM candidates)
    RETURNING f.signal_id
),
deleted_outcomes AS (
    DELETE FROM signal_outcomes o
    WHERE o.signal_id IN (SELECT id FROM candidates)
    RETURNING o.signal_id
)
DELETE FROM signals s
USING candidates c
WHERE s.id = c.id
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_outcome_features) >= 0
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_outcomes) >= 0;

cases.name: stonkpile/ListStoredSignalsForContract
cases.sql:
-- name: ListStoredSignalsForContract :many
SELECT s.id, s.strategy_id, st.name AS strategy_name, s.symbol, s.ts,
       s.direction, s.conviction, s.entry, s.stop, s.target, s.rationale,
       s.source, s.created_at, s.asset_type, s.timeframe, s.qty,
       s.source_votes, s.portfolio_hash, s.strategy_config_hash,
       s.strategy_evaluation_version, s.signal_payload
FROM signals s
JOIN strategies st ON st.id = s.strategy_id
JOIN tradebot_configurations c ON c.id = s.configuration_id
WHERE s.strategy_id = sqlc.arg(strategy_id)
  AND s.symbol = ANY(sqlc.arg(symbols)::text[])
  AND s.ts >= sqlc.arg(signal_from)
  AND s.ts <= sqlc.arg(signal_to)
  AND s.timeframe = sqlc.arg(timeframe)
  AND s.portfolio_hash = sqlc.arg(portfolio_hash)
  AND s.strategy_config_hash = sqlc.arg(strategy_config_hash)
  AND s.strategy_evaluation_version = sqlc.arg(evaluation_version)
  AND c.config_hash NOT LIKE 'legacy:%'
  AND (s.signal_payload IS NULL OR s.signal_payload = 'null'::jsonb)
ORDER BY s.ts ASC, s.symbol ASC, s.id ASC;

cases.name: stonkpile/ListStoredSignalPayloadsForContract
cases.sql:
-- name: ListStoredSignalPayloadsForContract :many
WITH page AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT s.id, s.ts
FROM signals s JOIN tradebot_configurations c ON c.id = s.configuration_id
WHERE s.strategy_id = sqlc.arg(strategy_id)
  AND s.symbol = sqlc.arg(symbol)
  AND (s.ts, s.id) > (sqlc.arg(cursor_ts)::timestamptz, sqlc.arg(cursor_id)::bigint)
  AND s.ts <= sqlc.arg(signal_to)
  AND s.timeframe = sqlc.arg(timeframe)
  AND s.portfolio_hash = sqlc.arg(portfolio_hash)
  AND s.strategy_config_hash = sqlc.arg(strategy_config_hash)
  AND s.strategy_evaluation_version = sqlc.arg(evaluation_version)
  AND c.config_hash NOT LIKE 'legacy:%'
  AND s.signal_payload IS NOT NULL
  AND s.signal_payload <> 'null'::jsonb
  AND s.configuration_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.ts ASC, s.id ASC
LIMIT sqlc.arg(page_limit)
)
SELECT s.id, s.signal_payload, page.ts FROM page
JOIN signals s ON s.id = page.id
ORDER BY page.ts, page.id;

cases.name: stonkpile/PruneLeastRecentlyGeneratedSignals
cases.sql:
-- name: PruneLeastRecentlyGeneratedSignals :execrows
WITH cold_contracts AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT sc.*, coverage.last_success_at
 FROM signal_contracts sc JOIN signal_coverage coverage ON coverage.contract_id=sc.id
 WHERE coverage.last_success_at < sqlc.arg(generated_before) AND coverage.status <> 'running'
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM signal_coverage_segments running WHERE running.contract_id=sc.id AND running.status='running')
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM signals s WHERE s.strategy_id=sc.strategy_id AND s.asset_type=sc.asset_type
 AND s.timeframe=sc.timeframe AND s.portfolio_hash=sc.portfolio_hash
 AND s.strategy_config_hash=sc.strategy_config_hash
 AND s.strategy_evaluation_version=sc.evaluation_version
 AND s.created_at < sqlc.arg(generated_before)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_intents i WHERE i.signal_id = s.id OFFSET 0)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_positions p
          WHERE p.entry_signal_id = s.id OR p.last_signal_id = s.id
          OFFSET 0
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_inventory_states tis
          WHERE tis.last_signal_id = s.id OFFSET 0
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM signal_notes n WHERE n.signal_id = s.id OFFSET 0)
)
 ORDER BY coverage.last_success_at,sc.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF coverage SKIP LOCKED
), candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT eligible.id,sc.id AS contract_id FROM cold_contracts sc
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT s.id FROM signals s WHERE s.strategy_id=sc.strategy_id AND s.asset_type=sc.asset_type
 AND s.timeframe=sc.timeframe AND s.portfolio_hash=sc.portfolio_hash
 AND s.strategy_config_hash=sc.strategy_config_hash
 AND s.strategy_evaluation_version=sc.evaluation_version
 AND s.created_at < sqlc.arg(generated_before)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_intents i WHERE i.signal_id = s.id OFFSET 0)
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_positions p
          WHERE p.entry_signal_id = s.id OR p.last_signal_id = s.id
          OFFSET 0
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_inventory_states tis
          WHERE tis.last_signal_id = s.id OFFSET 0
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM signal_notes n WHERE n.signal_id = s.id OFFSET 0)

   ORDER BY s.symbol,s.ts,s.id LIMIT sqlc.arg(batch_size) FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED
 ) eligible
 ORDER BY sc.last_success_at,sc.id,eligible.id LIMIT sqlc.arg(batch_size)
)
,
invalidated_coverage AS (
    UPDATE signal_coverage SET status='pending', generated_from=NULL, generated_to=NULL,
      last_error='signal cache evicted under storage budget', updated_at=now()
    WHERE contract_id IN (SELECT contract_id FROM candidates) RETURNING contract_id
),
invalidated_segments AS (
    UPDATE signal_coverage_segments SET status='invalidated',
      error_message='signal cache evicted under storage budget'
    WHERE contract_id IN (SELECT contract_id FROM candidates) AND status='complete'
    RETURNING contract_id
),
invalidated_cursors AS (
    DELETE FROM signal_contract_evaluations WHERE contract_id IN (SELECT contract_id FROM candidates)
    RETURNING contract_id
),
deleted_outcome_features AS (
    DELETE FROM signal_outcome_features f
    WHERE f.signal_id IN (SELECT id FROM candidates)
    RETURNING f.signal_id
),
deleted_outcomes AS (
    DELETE FROM signal_outcomes o
    WHERE o.signal_id IN (SELECT id FROM candidates)
    RETURNING o.signal_id
)
DELETE FROM signals s
USING candidates c
WHERE s.id = c.id
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_outcome_features) >= 0
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_outcomes) >= 0
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM invalidated_coverage) >= 0
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM invalidated_segments) >= 0
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM invalidated_cursors) >= 0;

       symbol, source, cluster_id, regime_state, breadth_participants,

cases.name: stonkpile/UpsertSignal
cases.sql:
-- name: UpsertSignal :one
WITH upserted AS (
INSERT INTO signals (configuration_id, strategy_id, symbol, ts, direction, conviction, entry, stop, target, rationale, source, asset_type, timeframe, qty, source_votes, portfolio_hash, strategy_config_hash, strategy_evaluation_version, signal_payload)
VALUES (NULLIF(sqlc.arg(configuration_id)::bigint, 0), sqlc.arg('strategy_id'), sqlc.arg('symbol'), sqlc.arg('ts'), sqlc.arg('direction'), sqlc.arg('conviction'), sqlc.arg('entry'), sqlc.arg('stop'), sqlc.arg('target'), sqlc.arg('rationale'), sqlc.arg('source'), sqlc.arg('asset_type'), sqlc.arg('timeframe'), sqlc.arg('qty'), coalesce(sqlc.arg('source_votes'), '[]'::jsonb), sqlc.arg('portfolio_hash'), sqlc.arg('strategy_config_hash'), sqlc.arg('strategy_evaluation_version'), sqlc.arg('signal_payload'))
ON CONFLICT (configuration_id, strategy_id, symbol, ts, timeframe, portfolio_hash, strategy_config_hash, strategy_evaluation_version)
    WHERE configuration_id IS NOT NULL
DO UPDATE
SET direction  = EXCLUDED.direction,
    conviction = EXCLUDED.conviction,
    entry      = EXCLUDED.entry,
    stop       = EXCLUDED.stop,
    target     = EXCLUDED.target,
    rationale  = EXCLUDED.rationale,
    source     = EXCLUDED.source,
    asset_type = EXCLUDED.asset_type,
    qty        = EXCLUDED.qty,
    source_votes = EXCLUDED.source_votes,
    signal_payload = EXCLUDED.signal_payload
WHERE (signals.direction, signals.conviction, signals.entry, signals.stop, signals.target,
       signals.rationale, signals.source, signals.asset_type, signals.qty, signals.source_votes, signals.signal_payload)
 IS DISTINCT FROM
      (EXCLUDED.direction, EXCLUDED.conviction, EXCLUDED.entry, EXCLUDED.stop, EXCLUDED.target,
       EXCLUDED.rationale, EXCLUDED.source, EXCLUDED.asset_type, EXCLUDED.qty, EXCLUDED.source_votes, EXCLUDED.signal_payload)
RETURNING id, strategy_id, symbol, ts, direction, conviction, entry, stop, target, rationale, source, created_at, asset_type, timeframe, qty, source_votes, portfolio_hash, strategy_config_hash, strategy_evaluation_version, signal_payload
)
SELECT * FROM upserted
UNION ALL
SELECT s.id, s.strategy_id, s.symbol, s.ts, s.direction, s.conviction, s.entry, s.stop, s.target,
       s.rationale, s.source, s.created_at, s.asset_type, s.timeframe, s.qty, s.source_votes,
       s.portfolio_hash, s.strategy_config_hash, s.strategy_evaluation_version, s.signal_payload
FROM signals s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM upserted)
  AND s.configuration_id = COALESCE(NULLIF(sqlc.arg(configuration_id)::bigint, 0),
      (SELECT id FROM tradebot_configurations WHERE config_hash = 'legacy:' || sqlc.arg('asset_type')::text || ':' || sqlc.arg('timeframe')::text))
  AND s.strategy_id = sqlc.arg('strategy_id') AND s.symbol = sqlc.arg('symbol') AND s.ts = sqlc.arg('ts') AND s.timeframe = sqlc.arg('timeframe')
  AND s.portfolio_hash = sqlc.arg('portfolio_hash') AND s.strategy_config_hash = sqlc.arg('strategy_config_hash') AND s.strategy_evaluation_version = sqlc.arg('strategy_evaluation_version');

cases.name: stonkpile/UpsertSignalsBatch
cases.sql:
-- name: UpsertSignalsBatch :execrows
-- Avoid no-op row locks/WAL before ON CONFLICT. Keep the same numeric casts
-- as insertion and preserve the conflict guard for concurrent real corrections.
WITH incoming AS (
SELECT unnest(sqlc.arg(configuration_ids)::bigint[]) AS configuration_id,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(strategy_ids)::bigint[]) AS strategy_id,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(symbols)::text[]) AS symbol,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(timestamps)::timestamptz[]) AS ts,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(directions)::text[]) AS direction,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(convictions)::double precision[])::numeric AS conviction,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(entries)::double precision[])::numeric AS entry,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(stops)::double precision[])::numeric AS stop,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(targets)::double precision[])::numeric AS target,
       nullif(unnest(sqlc.arg(rationales)::text[]), '') AS rationale,
       nullif(unnest(sqlc.arg(sources)::text[]), '') AS source,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(asset_types)::text[]) AS asset_type,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(timeframes)::text[]) AS timeframe,
       nullif(unnest(sqlc.arg(qtys)::double precision[]), 0)::numeric AS qty,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(source_votes)::jsonb[]) AS source_votes,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(portfolio_hashes)::text[]) AS portfolio_hash,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(strategy_config_hashes)::text[]) AS strategy_config_hash,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(strategy_evaluation_versions)::int[]) AS strategy_evaluation_version,
       unnest(sqlc.arg(signal_payloads)::jsonb[]) AS signal_payload
)
INSERT INTO signals (configuration_id, strategy_id, symbol, ts, direction, conviction, entry, stop, target, rationale, source, asset_type, timeframe, qty, source_votes, portfolio_hash, strategy_config_hash, strategy_evaluation_version, signal_payload)
SELECT i.* FROM incoming i
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM signals s
    WHERE s.configuration_id=i.configuration_id AND s.strategy_id=i.strategy_id AND s.symbol=i.symbol AND s.ts=i.ts AND s.timeframe=i.timeframe AND s.portfolio_hash=i.portfolio_hash AND s.strategy_config_hash=i.strategy_config_hash AND s.strategy_evaluation_version=i.strategy_evaluation_version
      AND (s.direction,s.conviction,s.entry,s.stop,s.target,s.rationale,s.source,s.asset_type,s.qty,s.source_votes,s.signal_payload)
          IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (i.direction,i.conviction,i.entry,i.stop,i.target,i.rationale,i.source,i.asset_type,i.qty,i.source_votes,i.signal_payload)
)
ORDER BY i.configuration_id,i.strategy_id,i.symbol,i.ts,i.timeframe,i.portfolio_hash,i.strategy_config_hash,i.strategy_evaluation_version
ON CONFLICT (configuration_id, strategy_id, symbol, ts, timeframe, portfolio_hash, strategy_config_hash, strategy_evaluation_version)
    WHERE configuration_id IS NOT NULL
DO UPDATE
SET direction  = EXCLUDED.direction,
    conviction = EXCLUDED.conviction,
    entry      = EXCLUDED.entry,
    stop       = EXCLUDED.stop,
    target     = EXCLUDED.target,
    rationale  = EXCLUDED.rationale,
    source     = EXCLUDED.source,
    asset_type = EXCLUDED.asset_type,
    qty        = EXCLUDED.qty,
    source_votes = EXCLUDED.source_votes,
    signal_payload = EXCLUDED.signal_payload
WHERE (signals.direction, signals.conviction, signals.entry, signals.stop, signals.target,
       signals.rationale, signals.source, signals.asset_type, signals.qty, signals.source_votes, signals.signal_payload)
 IS DISTINCT FROM
      (EXCLUDED.direction, EXCLUDED.conviction, EXCLUDED.entry, EXCLUDED.stop, EXCLUDED.target,
       EXCLUDED.rationale, EXCLUDED.source, EXCLUDED.asset_type, EXCLUDED.qty, EXCLUDED.source_votes, EXCLUDED.signal_payload);

cases.name: stonkpile/ListUngradedSignalsAtHorizon
cases.sql:
-- name: ListUngradedSignalsAtHorizon :many
-- Keep each scheduled grading activity bounded. Later pipeline runs pick up
-- the remaining oldest signals instead of monopolizing the shared DB pool.
SELECT s.id, s.strategy_id, s.symbol, s.ts, s.direction, s.conviction, s.entry, s.stop, s.target, s.rationale, s.source, s.created_at, s.asset_type, s.timeframe, s.qty, s.source_votes
FROM signals s
JOIN signal_grading_pending p ON p.signal_id = s.id AND p.horizon_days = sqlc.arg('horizon_days')
WHERE p.retry_at <= now()
  AND p.strategy_id = sqlc.arg('strategy_id')
  AND p.symbol = sqlc.arg('symbol')
  AND p.ts <= sqlc.arg('ts')
ORDER BY p.retry_at ASC, p.ts ASC, p.signal_id ASC
LIMIT 25;

cases.name: stonkpile/StrategyConfluenceBars
cases.sql:
-- name: StrategyConfluenceBars :many
-- Finds timestamps where the same strategy fires on 2+ symbols
-- within the same asset class, bucketed into sqlc.arg('bucket_seconds')-second time windows.
WITH bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    (date_trunc('minute', s.ts) - (EXTRACT(minute FROM s.ts)::int % (sqlc.arg('bucket_seconds')::int / 60)) * interval '1 minute')::timestamptz AS bucket,
    st.name AS strategy,
    s.asset_type,
    s.symbol,
    s.direction,
    s.conviction
  FROM signals s
  JOIN strategies st ON st.id = s.strategy_id
  WHERE s.ts >= sqlc.arg('from') AND s.ts <= sqlc.arg('through')
    AND s.direction <> 'flat' AND s.direction <> ''
    AND (sqlc.arg('timeframe') = '' OR s.timeframe = sqlc.arg('timeframe'))
),
clustered AS (
  SELECT bucket, strategy, asset_type,
         COUNT(DISTINCT symbol) AS symbol_count,
         MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY direction) AS majority_dir,
         AVG(conviction) AS avg_conviction
  FROM bucketed
  GROUP BY bucket, strategy, asset_type
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT symbol) >= 2
)
SELECT c.bucket AS ts, c.symbol_count,
       c.strategy, c.asset_type,
       c.majority_dir AS direction, c.avg_conviction AS conviction,
       b.symbol
FROM clustered c
JOIN bucketed b ON b.bucket = c.bucket AND b.strategy = c.strategy AND b.asset_type = c.asset_type
ORDER BY c.symbol_count DESC, c.bucket, b.symbol;

WITH requested_combos AS (
    SELECT unnest(sqlc.arg(strategy_ids)::bigint[]) AS strategy_id,
           unnest(sqlc.arg(symbols)::text[]) AS symbol,
           unnest(sqlc.arg(timeframes)::text[]) AS timeframe
), requested AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT strategy_id, symbol, timeframe FROM requested_combos
)
SELECT
  s.id, s.strategy_id, s.symbol, s.ts, s.direction, s.conviction, s.entry, s.stop, s.target,
  s.rationale, s.source, s.created_at, s.timeframe, s.qty, s.source_votes, s.configuration_id
FROM requested r
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT * FROM signals s
  WHERE s.strategy_id = r.strategy_id AND s.symbol = r.symbol AND s.timeframe = r.timeframe

cases.sql:
-- name: LatestDirectionalSignalsForScopedCombos :many
WITH requested AS (

           unnest(sqlc.arg(symbols)::text[]) AS symbol,
           unnest(sqlc.arg(timeframes)::text[]) AS timeframe,
           unnest(sqlc.arg(strategy_config_hashes)::text[]) AS strategy_config_hash
)
SELECT s.id, s.strategy_id, s.symbol, s.ts, s.direction, s.conviction, s.entry, s.stop, s.target,
  s.rationale, s.source, s.created_at, s.timeframe, s.qty, s.source_votes, s.configuration_id
FROM requested r
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT s.id, s.strategy_id, s.symbol, s.ts, s.direction, s.conviction, s.entry, s.stop, s.target,
    s.rationale, s.source, s.created_at, s.timeframe, s.qty, s.source_votes, s.configuration_id
  FROM signals s
  WHERE s.portfolio_hash = sqlc.arg(portfolio_hash)
    -- Scoped callers require nonempty provenance. State the partial-index
    -- predicate explicitly: generic prepared plans cannot infer it from $1.
    AND s.portfolio_hash <> ''
    AND s.strategy_evaluation_version = sqlc.arg(evaluation_version)
    AND s.strategy_config_hash = r.strategy_config_hash
    AND s.strategy_id = r.strategy_id
    AND s.symbol = r.symbol

FROM strategies st

  SELECT rationale, ts
  FROM signals
  WHERE strategy_id = st.id
    AND asset_type = 'equity'
    AND timeframe = sqlc.arg('timeframe')

SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.symbol, s.strategy_id, s.timeframe)
  s.id, s.strategy_id, st.name as strategy_name, s.symbol, s.ts, s.direction, s.conviction, s.entry, s.stop, s.target, s.rationale, s.source, s.created_at, s.asset_type, s.timeframe, s.qty, s.source_votes, s.configuration_id,
  s.portfolio_hash, s.strategy_config_hash, s.strategy_evaluation_version
FROM signals s
JOIN strategies st ON st.id = s.strategy_id
WHERE s.symbol = ANY(sqlc.arg(symbols)::text[])
  AND s.timeframe = ANY(sqlc.arg(timeframes)::text[])
  AND s.direction <> 'flat'
  AND (Cardinality(sqlc.arg(strategy_names)::text[]) = 0 OR st.name = ANY(sqlc.arg(strategy_names)::text[]))
  AND s.portfolio_hash = sqlc.arg(portfolio_hash)::text

cases.name: stonkpile/RecentMarketMapSignals
cases.sql:
-- name: RecentMarketMapSignals :many
-- Fetches directional signals created in the requested wall-clock window.
-- Market-map linger rules are applied by the API because each timeframe has a
-- different lifetime.
SELECT s.id,
       st.name AS strategy_name,
       s.symbol,
       coalesce(s.asset_type, '') AS asset_type,
       s.timeframe,
       s.direction,
       coalesce(s.conviction, 0)::float8 AS conviction,
       coalesce(s.entry, 0)::float8 AS entry,
       coalesce(s.stop, 0)::float8 AS stop,
       coalesce(s.target, 0)::float8 AS target,
       coalesce(s.qty, 0)::float8 AS qty,
       coalesce(s.rationale, '') AS rationale,
       coalesce(s.source, '') AS source,
       s.ts,
       s.created_at
FROM signals s
JOIN strategies st ON st.id = s.strategy_id
  WHERE s.symbol = ANY(sqlc.arg(symbols)::text[])
    AND s.created_at >= sqlc.arg(created_from)
    AND s.created_at <= sqlc.arg(created_to)
    -- Active map signals must be fresh in both processing time and market time.
    -- The market-time predicate lets Postgres use idx_signals_ts_tf instead of
    -- scanning historical backfills by their unindexed created_at timestamp.
    AND s.ts >= sqlc.arg(created_from)
    AND s.ts <= sqlc.arg(created_to)
    AND s.timeframe = sqlc.arg(timeframe)::text
  AND s.direction <> 'flat'
  AND s.direction <> ''
ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC;

cases.name: stonkpile/SelectMeanReversionPerformance
cases.sql:
-- name: SelectMeanReversionPerformance :many
-- Recent mean_reversion signal performance for dynamic portfolio scoring.
-- Used as a leading indicator: when MR avg_r turns positive after a bad period,
-- the symbol is typically 1-2 weeks away from a broader breakout run.
-- Returns avg_r, win_rate, total_r, and outcome count per symbol for the
-- mean_reversion strategy over the lookback window.
SELECT sig.symbol,
       COUNT(out.id)::int AS outcomes,
       COALESCE(AVG(out.r_multiple), 0)::float8 AS avg_r,
       COALESCE(AVG((out.r_multiple > 0)::int), 0)::float8 AS win_rate,
       COALESCE(SUM(out.r_multiple), 0)::float8 AS total_r
FROM signals sig
JOIN signal_outcomes out ON out.signal_id = sig.id
JOIN strategies s ON s.id = sig.strategy_id
WHERE s.name = 'mean_reversion'
  AND sig.asset_type = 'equity'
  AND sig.direction IN ('long', 'short')
  AND sig.ts >= sqlc.arg(since)::timestamptz
  AND sig.ts < sqlc.arg(until)::timestamptz
GROUP BY sig.symbol
HAVING COUNT(out.id) >= sqlc.arg(min_outcomes)::int
ORDER BY avg_r DESC;

cases.name: stonkpile/SelectStrategyPerformance
cases.sql:
-- name: SelectStrategyPerformance :many
-- Recent performance for all base strategies for dynamic portfolio scoring.
-- Returns avg_r, win_rate, total_r, and outcome count per symbol for strategies:
-- mean_reversion, breakout, vwap_reversion, trailing_stop.
-- Used to assess recent regime performance and identify turnaround candidates.
SELECT s.name AS strategy_name,
       sig.symbol,
       COUNT(out.id)::int AS outcomes,
       COALESCE(AVG(out.r_multiple), 0)::float8 AS avg_r,
       COALESCE(AVG((out.r_multiple > 0)::int), 0)::float8 AS win_rate,
       COALESCE(SUM(out.r_multiple), 0)::float8 AS total_r
FROM signals sig
JOIN signal_outcomes out ON out.signal_id = sig.id
JOIN strategies s ON s.id = sig.strategy_id
WHERE s.name IN ('mean_reversion', 'breakout', 'vwap_reversion', 'trailing_stop')
  AND sig.asset_type = 'equity'
  AND sig.direction IN ('long', 'short')
  AND sig.ts >= sqlc.arg(since)::timestamptz
  AND sig.ts < sqlc.arg(until)::timestamptz
GROUP BY s.name, sig.symbol
HAVING COUNT(out.id) >= sqlc.arg(min_outcomes)::int
ORDER BY s.name, sig.symbol;

       CASE WHEN (octet_length(coalesce(s.rationale, '')) + octet_length(coalesce(s.source, ''))) > 262144 THEN '' ELSE coalesce(s.source, '') END::text AS source,

 SELECT 1 FROM tax_history_reconciliation WHERE account_id=sqlc.arg(account_id) AND checked_through >= sqlc.arg(effective_at)

cases.name: stonkpile/ListTaxSummaries
cases.sql:
-- name: ListTaxSummaries :many
WITH filtered AS NOT MATERIALIZED (
    -- Let each aggregate read only its own columns, without spilling a shared
    -- materialized copy of the annual ledger (including broker payloads).
    SELECT account_id, liability_delta, held_delta, withdrawn_amount,
           federal_tax, state_tax, local_tax, niit_tax, taxable_amount,
           tax_character, complete, missing_data, effective_at
    FROM tax_liability_events WHERE tax_year = sqlc.arg(tax_year)
      AND (sqlc.arg(account_id)::text = '' OR account_id = sqlc.arg(account_id)::text)
), totals AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           sum(liability_delta)::double precision AS liability,
           greatest(0, sum(held_delta) - sum(withdrawn_amount))::double precision AS held,
           sum(withdrawn_amount)::double precision AS withdrawn,
           sum(federal_tax)::double precision AS federal, sum(state_tax)::double precision AS state,
           sum(local_tax)::double precision AS local, sum(niit_tax)::double precision AS niit,
           sum(taxable_amount) FILTER (WHERE tax_character IN ('ordinary','investment_ordinary'))::double precision AS ordinary,
           sum(taxable_amount) FILTER (WHERE tax_character = 'short_term')::double precision AS short_term,
           sum(taxable_amount) FILTER (WHERE tax_character = 'long_term')::double precision AS long_term,
           sum(taxable_amount) FILTER (WHERE tax_character = 'section_1256')::double precision AS section_1256,
           bool_and(complete)::boolean AS complete,
           sum(greatest(0, held_delta))::double precision AS reserve_added,
           sum(greatest(0, -held_delta))::double precision AS reserve_reduced,
           sum(greatest(0, taxable_amount))::double precision AS taxable_gains,
           sum(least(0, taxable_amount))::double precision AS taxable_losses,
           count(*)::bigint AS event_count,
           (max(effective_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') FILTER (WHERE 'forward_wash_sale_window'=ANY(missing_data)))::date + 31 AS pending_until
    FROM filtered GROUP BY account_id
), missing AS (
    SELECT account_id, array_agg(DISTINCT item)::text[] AS values
    FROM filtered, LATERAL unnest(missing_data) item
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       COALESCE(t.liability, 0)::double precision AS estimated_liability,
       COALESCE(t.held, 0)::double precision AS held_tax,
       COALESCE(t.withdrawn, 0)::double precision AS withdrawn_ytd,
       COALESCE(t.federal, 0)::double precision AS federal,
       COALESCE(t.state, 0)::double precision AS state,
       COALESCE(t.local, 0)::double precision AS local,
       COALESCE(t.niit, 0)::double precision AS niit,
       COALESCE(t.ordinary, 0)::double precision AS ordinary,
       COALESCE(t.short_term, 0)::double precision AS short_term,
       COALESCE(t.long_term, 0)::double precision AS long_term,
       COALESCE(t.section_1256, 0)::double precision AS section_1256,
       COALESCE(t.complete, false)::boolean AS complete,
       COALESCE(m.values, '{}')::text[] AS missing_data,
       COALESCE(t.reserve_added, 0)::double precision AS reserve_added,
       COALESCE(t.reserve_reduced, 0)::double precision AS reserve_reduced,
       COALESCE(t.taxable_gains, 0)::double precision AS taxable_gains,
       COALESCE(t.taxable_losses, 0)::double precision AS taxable_losses,
       COALESCE(t.event_count, 0)::bigint AS event_count,
       (t.pending_until::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::timestamptz AS pending_until,
       h.checked_through
FROM tax_accounts a
LEFT JOIN totals t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN missing m ON m.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN tax_history_reconciliation h ON h.account_id=a.account_id
WHERE (sqlc.arg(account_id)::text = '' OR a.account_id = sqlc.arg(account_id)::text)
ORDER BY a.account_id;

cases.name: stonkpile/TaxStateBefore
cases.sql:
-- name: TaxStateBefore :one
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT e.taxable_amount, e.tax_character, e.complete, e.missing_data
    FROM tax_liability_events e
    WHERE (e.account_id=sqlc.arg(account_id) OR e.account_id IN (
      SELECT jsonb_object_keys(s.account_summaries) FROM tax_shared_summary s
      WHERE s.tax_year=sqlc.arg(tax_year) AND s.account_summaries ? sqlc.arg(account_id)
    )) AND e.tax_year=sqlc.arg(tax_year)
      AND (e.event_type='realization' OR e.source_type='annual_carryover') AND e.effective_at < sqlc.arg(before)
), missing AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(DISTINCT item), '{}') values
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT missing_data FROM filtered
          WHERE cardinality(missing_data) > 0) AS distinct_missing,
         LATERAL unnest(distinct_missing.missing_data) item
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(sum(taxable_amount) FILTER (WHERE tax_character IN ('ordinary','investment_ordinary')),0)::double precision AS ordinary,
    COALESCE(sum(taxable_amount) FILTER (WHERE tax_character='short_term'),0)::double precision AS short_term,
    COALESCE(sum(taxable_amount) FILTER (WHERE tax_character='long_term'),0)::double precision AS long_term,
    COALESCE(sum(taxable_amount) FILTER (WHERE tax_character='section_1256'),0)::double precision AS section_1256,
    COALESCE(bool_and(complete), true)::boolean AS complete,
    (SELECT values FROM missing)::text[] AS missing_data
FROM filtered;

-- name: DailyTaxReport :one
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM desk_fills d
     WHERE d.account_id=sqlc.arg(account_id) AND d.filled_at >= sqlc.arg(from_at) AND d.filled_at < sqlc.arg(to_at))::bigint AS fills,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM tradebot_fill_events f
     JOIN tradebot_intents i ON i.intent_id = f.intent_id
     WHERE i.account_id=sqlc.arg(account_id) AND f.filled_at >= sqlc.arg(from_at) AND f.filled_at < sqlc.arg(to_at)
       AND f.action IN ('close_long', 'cover_short'))::bigint AS closed_trades,
    COALESCE((SELECT sum(taxable_amount) FROM tax_liability_events
     WHERE account_id=sqlc.arg(account_id) AND effective_at >= sqlc.arg(from_at) AND effective_at < sqlc.arg(to_at)
       AND event_type='realization'), 0)::double precision AS realized_pre_tax,
    COALESCE((SELECT sum(liability_delta) FROM tax_liability_events
     WHERE account_id=sqlc.arg(account_id) AND effective_at >= sqlc.arg(from_at) AND effective_at < sqlc.arg(to_at)
       AND event_type='realization'), 0)::double precision AS estimated_tax;

-- name: TaxHeldBalanceThrough :one
-- Replay retains estimated tax reserve across calendar years until an explicit
-- withdrawal. Live sizing must use that same cumulative spendable-capital
-- basis at its immutable decision watermark rather than silently releasing a
-- prior year's still-unpaid reserve on January 1.
SELECT greatest(0, COALESCE(sum(held_delta), 0) - COALESCE(sum(withdrawn_amount), 0))::double precision AS held
FROM tax_liability_events
WHERE account_id = sqlc.arg(account_id)
  AND effective_at <= sqlc.arg(as_of);

-- name: LoadTaxReconciliationState :one

    COALESCE(sum(taxable_amount) FILTER (WHERE tax_character = 'ordinary'), 0)::text AS ordinary,
    COALESCE(sum(taxable_amount) FILTER (WHERE tax_character = 'short_term'), 0)::text AS short_term,

cases.name: stonkpile/GetCurrentGeneration
stonkpile/CountTickerBacktestResultsForGeneration
stonkpile/SelectPriorWindowMomentum
cases.sql:
-- name: SelectPriorWindowMomentum :many
WITH selected_generation AS (
    SELECT r.generation
    FROM ticker_backtest_results r
    WHERE r.strategy LIKE sqlc.narg('strategy')
      AND r.timeframe = sqlc.narg('timeframe')
    GROUP BY r.generation
    -- Prefer the newest coherent cross-section. Tiny ad-hoc generations are
    -- diagnostics, not a market-wide selector; the historical generation with
    -- the most rows must not permanently eclipse every newer weekly run.
    ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT r.ticker) >= 2 AND COUNT(*) >= 4) DESC,
             r.generation DESC,
             COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.ticker)
       r.ticker,
       COALESCE(r.momentum_ema, 0)::float8 AS momentum_ema,
       COALESCE(r.momentum_ratio, 0)::float8 AS momentum_ratio,
       r.trades::float8 AS trades
FROM ticker_backtest_results r
JOIN selected_generation g USING (generation)
WHERE r.strategy LIKE sqlc.narg('strategy')
  AND r.strategy NOT LIKE '%_3m_now'
  AND r.timeframe = sqlc.narg('timeframe')
  AND r.to_date <= sqlc.narg('from_date')
  AND r.ticker = ANY(sqlc.narg('symbols')::text[])
ORDER BY r.ticker, r.to_date DESC, r.from_date DESC, r.id DESC;
