WHERE r.momentum_ema = 0 AND r.momentum_ratio = 0 AND r.trades > 0
ORDER BY r.ticker, r.from_date
LIMIT sqlc.arg('limit');

cases.name: stonkpile/SelectDynamicPortfolio
cases.sql:
-- name: SelectDynamicPortfolio :many
-- Composite score across all quarterly backtest windows (3m, walking back 2yr).
-- Only symbols with positive total_r (net profitable) across qualifying windows
-- are included. minWindows = 2 ensures multi-window consistency.
-- When regimeGate is true, windows from bearish SOXX regimes are downweighted
-- so tickers that only profited during bull runs don't dominate the ranking.
SELECT r.ticker, COALESCE(MAX(s.title), '')::text AS company_name,
       ROUND(SUM(r.total_r))::float8 AS total_r,
       AVG(r.win_rate) AS win_rate,
       AVG(r.sharpe) AS sharpe,
       MAX(r.max_dd_pct) AS max_dd_pct,
       ROUND(SUM(r.final_equity))::float8 AS final_equity,
       SUM(r.trades)::bigint AS trades,
       ROUND(SUM(r.total_r * r.win_rate * CASE
           WHEN @regime_gate::bool = false THEN 1.0
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct IS NULL THEN 0.7
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < -0.05 THEN 0.3
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < 0 THEN 0.7
           ELSE 1.0
       END))::float8 AS score,
       COUNT(*)::bigint AS windows
FROM ticker_backtest_results r
LEFT JOIN sec_tickers s ON s.ticker = r.ticker
WHERE r.generation = (SELECT generation FROM ticker_backtest_results GROUP BY generation ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)
  AND r.strategy LIKE @strategy
  AND r.timeframe = @timeframe
  AND r.trades >= @trades
GROUP BY r.ticker
HAVING COUNT(*) >= @min_windows::int AND SUM(r.total_r) > 0
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT @max_results;

cases.name: stonkpile/SelectDynamicPortfolioDetailed
cases.sql:
-- name: SelectDynamicPortfolioDetailed :many
-- Extended portfolio query with regime context, momentum, and time-range filtering.
-- Returns per-ticker aggregate stats plus regime breakdown (bull/bear/chop R)
-- so the CLI can show which regimes a symbol prints in.
-- Note: momentum filter (EMAd and MOM R > 0) was removed 2026-07-27 after
-- psql analysis showed momentum destroys value on 100% of equity symbols
-- (avg R = -0.491, 16.5% win rate). Mean reversion (avg R = +0.462, 64.4% win
-- rate) is the correct leading indicator for early-capture portfolio selection.
SELECT r.ticker, COALESCE(MAX(s.title), '')::text AS company_name,
       SUM(r.total_r)::double precision AS total_r,
       AVG(r.win_rate) AS win_rate,
       AVG(r.sharpe) AS sharpe,
       MAX(r.max_dd_pct)::double precision AS max_dd_pct,
       SUM(r.final_equity)::double precision AS final_equity,
       SUM(r.trades) AS trades,
       -- Momentum (averaged across windows)
       COALESCE(AVG(r.momentum_ema), 0)::double precision AS avg_momentum_ema,
       COALESCE(AVG(r.momentum_ratio), 0)::double precision AS avg_momentum_ratio,
       -- Regime context (averaged across windows)
       COALESCE(AVG(r.soxx_20d_pct), 0)::double precision AS avg_soxx_trend,
       COALESCE(AVG(r.vixy_20d_pct), 0)::double precision AS avg_vixy_trend,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.network_score), 0)::double precision AS network_score,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.network_profit_trades), 0)::bigint AS network_profit_trades,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.network_profit_r), 0)::double precision AS network_profit_r,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.network_loss_r), 0)::double precision AS network_loss_r,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.network_net_r), 0)::double precision AS network_net_r,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.network_profit_pnl), 0)::double precision AS network_profit_pnl,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.network_net_pnl), 0)::double precision AS network_net_pnl,
       -- Score with regime gating plus causal contribution to other symbols.
       (SUM(r.total_r * r.win_rate * CASE
           WHEN @regime_gate::bool = false THEN 1.0
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct IS NULL THEN 0.7
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < -0.05 THEN 0.3
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < 0 THEN 0.7
           ELSE 1.0
       END) + COALESCE(SUM(r.network_net_r), 0))::double precision AS score,
       COUNT(*) AS windows,
       -- Per-regime R breakdown
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct > 0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS bull_r,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < -0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS bear_r,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct >= -0.05 AND r.soxx_20d_pct <= 0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS chop_r,
       -- Window date range
       MIN(r.from_date)::text AS earliest_window,
       MAX(r.to_date)::text AS latest_window,
       SUM(r.final_equity - 100000.0)::double precision AS realized_pnl,
       SUM(r.unrealized_pnl)::double precision AS unrealized_pnl,
       SUM(r.final_equity + r.unrealized_pnl - 100000.0)::double precision AS marked_balance
FROM ticker_backtest_results r
LEFT JOIN sec_tickers s ON s.ticker = r.ticker
WHERE r.generation = (SELECT generation FROM ticker_backtest_results GROUP BY generation ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)
  AND r.strategy LIKE @strategy
  AND r.timeframe = @timeframe
  AND r.trades >= @trades
  AND r.from_date >= @from_date
  AND r.to_date <= @to_date
GROUP BY r.ticker
HAVING COUNT(*) >= @min_windows::int
   AND (SUM(r.total_r) > 0 OR COALESCE(SUM(r.network_net_r), 0) > 0)
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT @max_results;

cases.name: stonkpile/SelectDynamicPortfolioAsOf
cases.sql:
-- name: SelectDynamicPortfolioAsOf :many
-- Same as SelectDynamicPortfolio but filters by to_date <= @as_of_date instead
-- of using the latest generation. This allows walk-forward backtests to query
-- what the dynamic portfolio WOULD have been at any historical date without
-- lookahead bias. Each window in ticker_backtest_results represents a specific
-- 3-month period ending at to_date, so to_date <= cutoff gives us only windows
-- that would have been known at that cutoff.
SELECT r.ticker, COALESCE(MAX(s.title), '')::text AS company_name,
       ROUND(SUM(r.total_r))::float8 AS total_r,
       AVG(r.win_rate) AS win_rate,
       AVG(r.sharpe) AS sharpe,
       MAX(r.max_dd_pct) AS max_dd_pct,
       ROUND(SUM(r.final_equity))::float8 AS final_equity,
       SUM(r.trades)::bigint AS trades,
       ROUND(SUM(r.total_r * r.win_rate * CASE
           WHEN @regime_gate::bool = false THEN 1.0
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct IS NULL THEN 0.7
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < -0.05 THEN 0.3
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < 0 THEN 0.7
           ELSE 1.0
       END))::float8 AS score,
       COUNT(*)::bigint AS windows
FROM ticker_backtest_results r
LEFT JOIN sec_tickers s ON s.ticker = r.ticker
WHERE r.to_date <= @as_of_date::date
  AND r.strategy LIKE @strategy
  AND r.timeframe = @timeframe
  AND r.trades >= @trades
GROUP BY r.ticker
HAVING COUNT(*) >= @min_windows::int AND SUM(r.total_r) > 0
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT @max_results;

cases.name: stonkpile/ListTickerBacktestResultsByTicker

-- name: ListTickerBacktestResultsByTicker :many
-- Per-window results for a specific ticker, for drill-down view.
SELECT r.id, r.cik, r.ticker, r.strategy, r.timeframe, r.from_date, r.to_date,
       r.trades, r.win_rate, r.expect_r, r.profit_factor, r.total_r, r.sharpe,
       r.max_dd_pct, r.max_dd_dollars, r.final_equity, r.generation,

cases.name: stonkpile/SelectDynamicPortfolioV2
cases.sql:
-- name: SelectDynamicPortfolioV2 :many
-- V2: with mean reversion boost weight and lookback period for dynamic portfolio scoring.
-- Joins ticker_backtest_results with recent mean_reversion signal performance to boost
-- symbols showing positive MR turnaround. The mrWeight parameter controls how much
-- the MR signal influences the final score (0 = disabled, 1.0 = full boost).
-- mrLookback is the lookback window in days for MR signal performance.
SELECT r.ticker, COALESCE(MAX(s.title), '')::text AS company_name,
       SUM(r.total_r)::double precision AS total_r,
       AVG(r.win_rate) AS win_rate,
       AVG(r.sharpe) AS sharpe,
       MAX(r.max_dd_pct)::double precision AS max_dd_pct,
       SUM(r.final_equity)::double precision AS final_equity,
       SUM(r.trades) AS trades,
       COALESCE(AVG(r.momentum_ema), 0)::double precision AS avg_momentum_ema,
       COALESCE(AVG(r.momentum_ratio), 0)::double precision AS avg_momentum_ratio,
       COALESCE(AVG(r.soxx_20d_pct), 0)::double precision AS avg_soxx_trend,
       COALESCE(AVG(r.vixy_20d_pct), 0)::double precision AS avg_vixy_trend,
       -- Base score with regime gating
       SUM(r.total_r * r.win_rate * CASE
           WHEN sqlc.narg('regime_gate')::bool = false THEN 1.0
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct IS NULL THEN 0.7
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < -0.05 THEN 0.3
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < 0 THEN 0.7
           ELSE 1.0
       END)::double precision AS base_score,
       -- Mean reversion boost (NULL if no MR data)
       COALESCE(MAX(mr.avg_r), 0)::float8 AS mr_avg_r,
       COALESCE(MAX(mr.win_rate), 0)::float8 AS mr_win_rate,
       -- Final score: own performance + MR boost + causal profit/loss on other
       -- symbols. network_net_r is in the same risk-unit scale as total_r and
       -- includes losing beneficiary trades, preventing noisy breadth symbols
       -- from receiving one-sided credit.
       (SUM(r.total_r * r.win_rate * CASE
           WHEN sqlc.narg('regime_gate')::bool = false THEN 1.0
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct IS NULL THEN 0.7
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < -0.05 THEN 0.3
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < 0 THEN 0.7
           ELSE 1.0
        END)::double precision +
        COALESCE(MAX(mr.avg_r) * sqlc.narg('mr_weight')::float8, 0)::double precision +
        COALESCE(SUM(r.network_net_r), 0)::double precision)::numeric AS score,
       COUNT(*) AS windows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct > 0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS bull_r,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < -0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS bear_r,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct >= -0.05 AND r.soxx_20d_pct <= 0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS chop_r,
       MIN(r.from_date)::text AS earliest_window,
       MAX(r.to_date)::text AS latest_window,
       SUM(r.final_equity - 100000.0)::double precision AS realized_pnl,
       SUM(r.unrealized_pnl)::double precision AS unrealized_pnl,
       SUM(r.final_equity + r.unrealized_pnl - 100000.0)::double precision AS marked_balance
FROM ticker_backtest_results r
LEFT JOIN sec_tickers s ON s.ticker = r.ticker
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT sig.symbol,
           COALESCE(AVG(out.r_multiple), 0)::float8 AS avg_r,
           COALESCE(AVG((out.r_multiple > 0)::int), 0)::float8 AS win_rate
    FROM signals sig
    JOIN signal_outcomes out ON out.signal_id = sig.id
    JOIN strategies st ON st.id = sig.strategy_id
    WHERE st.name = 'mean_reversion'
      AND sig.asset_type = 'equity'
      AND sig.direction IN ('long', 'short')
      AND sig.ts >= NOW() - (MAKE_INTERVAL(days => sqlc.narg('mr_lookback')))
    GROUP BY sig.symbol
    HAVING COUNT(out.id) >= 5
) mr ON mr.symbol = r.ticker
WHERE r.generation = (SELECT generation FROM ticker_backtest_results GROUP BY generation ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)
  AND r.strategy LIKE sqlc.narg('strategy')
  AND r.timeframe = sqlc.narg('timeframe')
  AND r.trades >= sqlc.narg('trades')
  AND r.from_date >= sqlc.narg('from_date')
  AND r.to_date <= sqlc.narg('to_date')
GROUP BY r.ticker
HAVING COUNT(*) >= sqlc.narg('min_windows')::int
  AND (SUM(r.total_r) > 0 OR COALESCE(SUM(r.network_net_r), 0) > 0)
  -- Require at least one positive momentum indicator (EMAd or MOM R)
  AND (COALESCE(AVG(r.momentum_ema), 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(AVG(r.momentum_ratio), 0) > 0)
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT sqlc.narg('max_results');

cases.name: stonkpile/SelectDynamicPortfolioV4
cases.sql:
-- name: SelectDynamicPortfolioV4 :many
-- V4 applies momentum-transition and trade-count leading indicators before
-- the final LIMIT. Every source row is scoped to one deterministic generation
-- and timeframe, and the current/prior windows use deterministic ordering.
WITH selected_generation AS (
    SELECT r.generation
    FROM ticker_backtest_results r
    WHERE r.strategy LIKE sqlc.narg('strategy')
      AND r.timeframe = sqlc.narg('timeframe')
    GROUP BY r.generation
    -- Prefer the newest coherent cross-section. Tiny ad-hoc generations are
    -- diagnostics, not a market-wide selector; the historical generation with
    -- the most rows must not permanently eclipse every newer weekly run.
    ORDER BY (COUNT(DISTINCT r.ticker) >= 2 AND COUNT(*) >= 4) DESC,
             r.generation DESC,
             COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
scoped AS (
    SELECT r.*
    FROM ticker_backtest_results r
    JOIN selected_generation g USING (generation)
    WHERE r.strategy LIKE sqlc.narg('strategy')
      AND r.timeframe = sqlc.narg('timeframe')
      AND r.from_date >= sqlc.narg('from_date')
      AND r.to_date <= sqlc.narg('to_date')
),
current_window AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.ticker)
           r.ticker, r.id, r.from_date, r.to_date, r.trades,
           r.win_rate, r.momentum_ema, r.momentum_ratio,
           r.soxx_20d_pct, r.vixy_20d_pct,
           r.semi_affinity_events,
           r.semi_affinity_smh_rate, r.semi_affinity_soxx_rate,
           r.semi_affinity_soxq_rate, r.semi_affinity_xsd_rate,
           r.semi_affinity_psi_rate, r.semi_affinity_ftxl_rate,
           r.semi_leadership_trend_pct
    FROM scoped r
    ORDER BY r.ticker, r.to_date DESC, r.from_date DESC, r.id DESC
),
affinity_medians AS (
    SELECT
        percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY semi_affinity_smh_rate)
            FILTER (WHERE semi_affinity_events >= 20 AND semi_affinity_smh_rate IS NOT NULL) AS smh,
        percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY semi_affinity_soxx_rate)
            FILTER (WHERE semi_affinity_events >= 20 AND semi_affinity_soxx_rate IS NOT NULL) AS soxx,
        percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY semi_affinity_soxq_rate)
            FILTER (WHERE semi_affinity_events >= 20 AND semi_affinity_soxq_rate IS NOT NULL) AS soxq,
        percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY semi_affinity_xsd_rate)
            FILTER (WHERE semi_affinity_events >= 20 AND semi_affinity_xsd_rate IS NOT NULL) AS xsd
    FROM current_window
),
affinity_shrunk AS (
    SELECT c.*,
           (c.semi_affinity_events * c.semi_affinity_smh_rate + 20 * m.smh) /
               (c.semi_affinity_events + 20) AS shrunk_smh,
           (c.semi_affinity_events * c.semi_affinity_soxx_rate + 20 * m.soxx) /
               (c.semi_affinity_events + 20) AS shrunk_soxx,
           (c.semi_affinity_events * c.semi_affinity_soxq_rate + 20 * m.soxq) /
               (c.semi_affinity_events + 20) AS shrunk_soxq,
           (c.semi_affinity_events * c.semi_affinity_xsd_rate + 20 * m.xsd) /
               (c.semi_affinity_events + 20) AS shrunk_xsd
    FROM current_window c
    CROSS JOIN affinity_medians m
),
affinity_ranked AS (
    SELECT a.ticker,
           (
               0.45 * percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.shrunk_smh) +
               0.35 * percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.shrunk_soxx) +
               0.10 * percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.shrunk_soxq) +
               0.10 * percent_rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.shrunk_xsd)
           )::double precision AS semi_affinity_score
    FROM affinity_shrunk a
    WHERE a.semi_affinity_events >= 20
      AND a.shrunk_smh IS NOT NULL
      AND a.shrunk_soxx IS NOT NULL
      AND a.shrunk_soxq IS NOT NULL
      AND a.shrunk_xsd IS NOT NULL
),
current_features AS (
    SELECT c.*, a.semi_affinity_score
    FROM current_window c
    LEFT JOIN affinity_ranked a USING (ticker)
),
prior_window AS (
    SELECT c.ticker,
           p.momentum_ema AS prior_momentum_ema,
           p.momentum_ratio AS prior_momentum_ratio,
           p.trades AS prior_trades
    FROM current_window c
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT r.momentum_ema, r.momentum_ratio, r.trades
        FROM ticker_backtest_results r
        JOIN selected_generation g USING (generation)
        WHERE r.ticker = c.ticker
          AND r.strategy LIKE sqlc.narg('strategy')
          AND r.timeframe = sqlc.narg('timeframe')
          AND r.from_date >= sqlc.narg('from_date')
          AND r.to_date <= sqlc.narg('to_date')
          AND r.to_date <= c.from_date
          AND r.id <> c.id
        ORDER BY r.to_date DESC, r.from_date DESC, r.id DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) p ON true
),
macro AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(r.soxx_20d_pct, 0)::float8 AS soxx,
           COALESCE(r.vixy_20d_pct, 0)::float8 AS vixy
    FROM scoped r
    WHERE r.trades >= 5
      AND r.soxx_20d_pct IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY r.to_date DESC, r.from_date DESC, r.id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
mr AS (
    SELECT sig.symbol,
           COALESCE(AVG(out.r_multiple), 0)::float8 AS avg_r,
           COALESCE(AVG((out.r_multiple > 0)::int), 0)::float8 AS win_rate
    FROM signals sig
    JOIN signal_outcomes out ON out.signal_id = sig.id
    JOIN strategies st ON st.id = sig.strategy_id
    WHERE st.name = 'mean_reversion'
      AND sig.asset_type = 'equity'
      AND sig.direction IN ('long', 'short')
      AND sig.ts >= sqlc.narg('as_of')::timestamptz -
          MAKE_INTERVAL(days => sqlc.narg('mr_lookback')::int)
      AND sig.ts <= sqlc.narg('as_of')::timestamptz
      AND out.graded_at <= sqlc.narg('as_of')::timestamptz
    GROUP BY sig.symbol
    HAVING COUNT(out.id) >= 5
),
base AS (
    SELECT r.ticker, COALESCE(MAX(s.title), '')::text AS company_name,
           SUM(r.total_r)::double precision AS total_r,
           AVG(r.win_rate)::double precision AS win_rate,
           AVG(r.sharpe)::double precision AS sharpe,
           MAX(r.max_dd_pct)::double precision AS max_dd_pct,
           SUM(r.final_equity)::double precision AS final_equity,
           SUM(r.trades)::bigint AS trades,
           COALESCE(AVG(r.momentum_ema), 0)::double precision AS avg_momentum_ema,
           COALESCE(AVG(r.momentum_ratio), 0)::double precision AS avg_momentum_ratio,
           COALESCE(AVG(r.soxx_20d_pct), 0)::double precision AS avg_soxx_trend,
           COALESCE(AVG(r.vixy_20d_pct), 0)::double precision AS avg_vixy_trend,
           COALESCE(SUM(r.network_score), 0)::double precision AS network_score,
           COALESCE(SUM(r.network_profit_trades), 0)::bigint AS network_profit_trades,
           COALESCE(SUM(r.network_profit_r), 0)::double precision AS network_profit_r,
           COALESCE(SUM(r.network_loss_r), 0)::double precision AS network_loss_r,
           COALESCE(SUM(r.network_net_r), 0)::double precision AS network_net_r,
           COALESCE(SUM(r.network_profit_pnl), 0)::double precision AS network_profit_pnl,
           COALESCE(SUM(r.network_net_pnl), 0)::double precision AS network_net_pnl,
           (
               SUM(r.total_r * r.win_rate * CASE
                   WHEN sqlc.narg('regime_gate')::bool = false THEN 1.0
                   WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct IS NULL THEN 0.7
                   WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < -0.05 THEN 0.3
                   WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < 0 THEN 0.7
                   ELSE 1.0
               END)::double precision +
               COALESCE(MAX(mr.avg_r) * sqlc.narg('mr_weight')::float8, 0) +
               COALESCE(SUM(r.network_net_r), 0)
           )::double precision AS base_score,
           COUNT(*)::bigint AS windows,
           SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct > 0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS bull_r,
           SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < -0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS bear_r,
           SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct >= -0.05 AND r.soxx_20d_pct <= 0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS chop_r,
           MIN(r.from_date)::text AS earliest_window,
           MAX(r.to_date)::text AS latest_window,
           SUM(r.final_equity - 100000.0)::double precision AS realized_pnl,
           SUM(r.unrealized_pnl)::double precision AS unrealized_pnl,
           SUM(r.final_equity + r.unrealized_pnl - 100000.0)::double precision AS marked_balance
    FROM scoped r
    LEFT JOIN sec_tickers s ON s.ticker = r.ticker
    LEFT JOIN mr ON mr.symbol = r.ticker
    WHERE r.trades >= GREATEST(
        sqlc.narg('min_trades')::int,
        sqlc.narg('min_trades_ext')::int
    )
    GROUP BY r.ticker
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= GREATEST(
        sqlc.narg('min_windows')::int,
        sqlc.narg('min_windows_ext')::int
    )
      AND (SUM(r.total_r) > 0 OR COALESCE(SUM(r.network_net_r), 0) > 0)
),
contextual AS (
    SELECT b.*, c.trades AS current_trades,
           c.win_rate AS current_win_rate,
           c.momentum_ema AS current_momentum_ema,
           c.momentum_ratio AS current_momentum_ratio,
           c.semi_affinity_score,
           c.semi_affinity_events,
           c.semi_affinity_smh_rate,
           c.semi_affinity_soxx_rate,
           c.semi_affinity_soxq_rate,
           c.semi_affinity_xsd_rate,
           c.semi_affinity_psi_rate,
           c.semi_affinity_ftxl_rate,
           c.semi_leadership_trend_pct,
           p.prior_trades, p.prior_momentum_ema, p.prior_momentum_ratio,
           COALESCE(m.soxx, 0) AS macro_soxx,
           COALESCE(m.vixy, 0) AS macro_vixy,
           CASE
             WHEN p.prior_momentum_ema IS NULL OR p.prior_momentum_ratio IS NULL THEN ''
             WHEN p.prior_momentum_ema > 0 AND p.prior_momentum_ratio > 0
              AND c.momentum_ema < 0 AND c.momentum_ratio < 0 THEN 'CULL'
             WHEN p.prior_momentum_ema < 0 AND p.prior_momentum_ratio < 0
              AND c.momentum_ema < 0 AND c.momentum_ratio < 0 THEN 'DROP'
             WHEN p.prior_momentum_ema > 0 AND p.prior_momentum_ratio > 0
              AND c.momentum_ema > 0 AND c.momentum_ratio > 0
              AND NOT (
                  (COALESCE(m.soxx, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(m.vixy, 0) < -1.0)
                  OR
                  (COALESCE(m.soxx, 0) > -0.05 AND COALESCE(m.soxx, 0) < 0.05
                   AND COALESCE(m.vixy, 0) > 1.0)
              ) THEN 'WATCH'
             ELSE ''
           END::text AS transition_action
    FROM base b
    JOIN current_features c USING (ticker)
    LEFT JOIN prior_window p USING (ticker)
    LEFT JOIN macro m ON true
),
dynamic_components AS (
    SELECT c.*,
           COALESCE(
               (c.realized_pnl - MIN(c.realized_pnl) OVER ()) /
               NULLIF(MAX(c.realized_pnl) OVER () - MIN(c.realized_pnl) OVER (), 0),
               0.5
           )::double precision AS dyn_pnl,
           COALESCE(
               (c.current_momentum_ema - MIN(c.current_momentum_ema) OVER ()) /
               NULLIF(
                   MAX(c.current_momentum_ema) OVER () -
                   MIN(c.current_momentum_ema) OVER (),
                   0
               ),
               0.5
           )::double precision AS dyn_ema,
           GREATEST(
               0,
               LEAST(COALESCE(c.current_momentum_ratio, 0), 2.0) - 0.5
           )::double precision AS dyn_momentum,
           GREATEST(COALESCE(c.current_win_rate, 0), 0.1)::double precision
               AS dyn_win_rate
    FROM contextual c
),
dynamic_scored AS (
    SELECT d.*,
           CASE
             -- Match the backtest-pane DYN vetoes: a formerly profitable
             -- symbol whose recent EMA or momentum ratio has broken down
             -- must rank below a healthy symbol. Network value is kept
             -- separate below so a measured catalyst is not discarded.
             WHEN d.realized_pnl > 0
              AND (d.current_momentum_ema <= 0 OR d.current_momentum_ratio < 0.8)
               THEN -ABS(
                   d.dyn_pnl * 0.30 +
                   d.dyn_ema * 0.35 +
                   d.dyn_momentum * 0.15 +
                   d.dyn_win_rate * 0.15
               ) * 0.5
             ELSE
                 d.dyn_pnl * 0.30 +
                 d.dyn_ema * 0.35 +
                 d.dyn_momentum * 0.15 +
                 d.dyn_win_rate * 0.15
           END::double precision AS dynamic_score
    FROM dynamic_components d
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT d.*,
           (
               -- Own-trade momentum describes whether this symbol's trading
               -- season is improving; it must not erase causal profit the
               -- symbol still creates in other names' confluence clusters.
               (d.base_score - d.network_net_r) *
               CASE d.transition_action
                 WHEN 'WATCH' THEN 0.8
                 WHEN 'CULL' THEN 0.3
                 WHEN 'DROP' THEN 0.2
                 ELSE 1.0
               END *
               -- DYN is intentionally bounded. It can promote a healthy
               -- emerging season and suppress a decaying one, but it cannot
               -- overwhelm measured network contribution.
               GREATEST(
                   0.5,
                   LEAST(1.25, 0.75 + d.dynamic_score * 0.5)
               ) *
                CASE
                  WHEN d.prior_trades > 0 AND d.current_trades::float8 / d.prior_trades < 0.8 THEN 1.6
                  WHEN d.prior_trades > 0 AND d.current_trades::float8 / d.prior_trades > 2.0 THEN 0.3
                  ELSE 1.0
                END +
                -- Marginal beneficiary R overlaps across contributors and is
                -- not fully portable after taking a top-N slice. Preserve its
                -- sign and ordering while discounting double-counted scale.
                SIGN(d.network_net_r) * SQRT(ABS(d.network_net_r))
           )::double precision AS score,
           CASE
             WHEN d.prior_trades > 0 AND d.current_trades::float8 / d.prior_trades < 0.8
               -- Lower recent activity was the strongest positive leading
               -- bucket in chronological validation. Do not call this DROP:
               -- DROP already means persistently negative own momentum.
               THEN CONCAT_WS('/', NULLIF(d.transition_action, ''), 'QUIET')
             WHEN d.prior_trades > 0 AND d.current_trades::float8 / d.prior_trades > 2.0
               THEN CONCAT_WS('/', NULLIF(d.transition_action, ''), 'SURGE')
             ELSE d.transition_action
           END::text AS momentum_transition
    FROM dynamic_scored d
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT r.*
    FROM ranked r
    -- CULL/DROP are adverse own-symbol transitions. They earn a portfolio
    -- slot only when measured cluster attribution proves that they remain a
    -- useful catalyst for other symbols. PART# is a binary evidence floor;
    -- larger counts and SLA rank do not increase score.
    WHERE r.semi_affinity_events >= 20
      AND (
          r.transition_action NOT IN ('CULL', 'DROP')
          OR r.network_net_r > 0
      )
)
SELECT ticker, company_name, total_r, win_rate, sharpe, max_dd_pct,
       final_equity, trades, score, dynamic_score, windows, momentum_transition,
       avg_momentum_ema, avg_momentum_ratio, avg_soxx_trend, avg_vixy_trend,
       network_score, network_profit_trades, network_profit_r, network_loss_r,
       network_net_r, network_profit_pnl, network_net_pnl,
       semi_affinity_score, semi_affinity_events,
       semi_affinity_smh_rate, semi_affinity_soxx_rate,
       semi_affinity_soxq_rate, semi_affinity_xsd_rate,
       semi_affinity_psi_rate, semi_affinity_ftxl_rate,
       semi_leadership_trend_pct,
       bull_r, bear_r, chop_r, earliest_window, latest_window,
       realized_pnl, unrealized_pnl, marked_balance
FROM eligible
ORDER BY score DESC, ticker ASC
LIMIT sqlc.narg('max_results');

cases.name: stonkpile/SelectDynamicPortfolioV3
cases.sql:
-- name: SelectDynamicPortfolioV3 :many
-- V3: with enhanced regime/momentum context and optional symbol filtering.
-- Extends V2 with additional minTrades and minWindows parameters for stricter
-- filtering. This allows the caller to require more trades and more windows
-- for inclusion in the dynamic portfolio, useful for higher-confidence selections.
-- The mrWeight and mrLookback parameters work the same as V2 for MR boost.
SELECT r.ticker, COALESCE(MAX(s.title), '')::text AS company_name,
       SUM(r.total_r)::double precision AS total_r,
       AVG(r.win_rate) AS win_rate,
       AVG(r.sharpe) AS sharpe,
       MAX(r.max_dd_pct)::double precision AS max_dd_pct,
       SUM(r.final_equity)::double precision AS final_equity,
       SUM(r.trades) AS trades,
       COALESCE(AVG(r.momentum_ema), 0)::double precision AS avg_momentum_ema,
       COALESCE(AVG(r.momentum_ratio), 0)::double precision AS avg_momentum_ratio,
       COALESCE(AVG(r.soxx_20d_pct), 0)::double precision AS avg_soxx_trend,
       COALESCE(AVG(r.vixy_20d_pct), 0)::double precision AS avg_vixy_trend,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.network_score), 0)::double precision AS network_score,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.network_profit_trades), 0)::bigint AS network_profit_trades,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.network_profit_r), 0)::double precision AS network_profit_r,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.network_loss_r), 0)::double precision AS network_loss_r,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.network_net_r), 0)::double precision AS network_net_r,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.network_profit_pnl), 0)::double precision AS network_profit_pnl,
       COALESCE(SUM(r.network_net_pnl), 0)::double precision AS network_net_pnl,
       -- Base score with regime gating
       SUM(r.total_r * r.win_rate * CASE
           WHEN sqlc.narg('regime_gate')::bool = false THEN 1.0
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct IS NULL THEN 0.7
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < -0.05 THEN 0.3
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < 0 THEN 0.7
           ELSE 1.0
       END)::double precision AS base_score,
       -- Mean reversion boost (NULL if no MR data)
       COALESCE(MAX(mr.avg_r), 0)::float8 AS mr_avg_r,
       COALESCE(MAX(mr.win_rate), 0)::float8 AS mr_win_rate,
       -- Final score: own performance + MR boost + causal profit/loss on other
       -- symbols. network_net_r includes losing beneficiary trades so breadth
       -- activity alone cannot dominate the ranking.
       (SUM(r.total_r * r.win_rate * CASE
           WHEN sqlc.narg('regime_gate')::bool = false THEN 1.0
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct IS NULL THEN 0.7
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < -0.05 THEN 0.3
           WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < 0 THEN 0.7
           ELSE 1.0
        END)::double precision +
        COALESCE(MAX(mr.avg_r) * sqlc.narg('mr_weight')::float8, 0)::double precision +
        COALESCE(SUM(r.network_net_r), 0)::double precision)::numeric AS score,
       COUNT(*) AS windows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct > 0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS bull_r,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct < -0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS bear_r,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.soxx_20d_pct >= -0.05 AND r.soxx_20d_pct <= 0.05 THEN r.total_r ELSE 0 END)::double precision AS chop_r,
       MIN(r.from_date)::text AS earliest_window,
       MAX(r.to_date)::text AS latest_window,
       SUM(r.final_equity - 100000.0)::double precision AS realized_pnl,
       SUM(r.unrealized_pnl)::double precision AS unrealized_pnl,
       SUM(r.final_equity + r.unrealized_pnl - 100000.0)::double precision AS marked_balance
FROM ticker_backtest_results r
LEFT JOIN sec_tickers s ON s.ticker = r.ticker
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT sig.symbol,
           COALESCE(AVG(out.r_multiple), 0)::float8 AS avg_r,
           COALESCE(AVG((out.r_multiple > 0)::int), 0)::float8 AS win_rate
    FROM signals sig
    JOIN signal_outcomes out ON out.signal_id = sig.id
    JOIN strategies st ON st.id = sig.strategy_id
    WHERE st.name = 'mean_reversion'
      AND sig.asset_type = 'equity'
      AND sig.direction IN ('long', 'short')
      AND sig.ts >= NOW() - (MAKE_INTERVAL(days => sqlc.narg('mr_lookback')))
    GROUP BY sig.symbol
    HAVING COUNT(out.id) >= 5
) mr ON mr.symbol = r.ticker
WHERE r.generation = (SELECT generation FROM ticker_backtest_results GROUP BY generation ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)
  AND r.strategy LIKE sqlc.narg('strategy')
  AND r.timeframe = sqlc.narg('timeframe')
  AND r.trades >= sqlc.narg('trades')
  AND r.from_date >= sqlc.narg('from_date')
  AND r.to_date <= sqlc.narg('to_date')
GROUP BY r.ticker
HAVING COUNT(*) >= sqlc.narg('min_windows_ext')::int
  AND (SUM(r.total_r) > 0 OR COALESCE(SUM(r.network_net_r), 0) > 0)
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT sqlc.narg('max_results');

-- name: InsertTradebotIntent :one
INSERT INTO tradebot_intents (
  intent_id, scope_id, mode, account_id, broker, asset_class, strategy,
  timeframe, symbol, signal_id, decision_bar, action, direction, qty,
  reference_price, stop_price, target_price, reason, policy, status,

) VALUES (
  sqlc.arg('intent_id'), sqlc.arg('scope_id'), sqlc.arg('mode'), sqlc.arg('account_id'), sqlc.arg('broker'), sqlc.arg('asset_class'), sqlc.arg('strategy'),
  sqlc.arg('timeframe'), sqlc.arg('symbol'), sqlc.narg('signal_id'), sqlc.arg('decision_bar'), sqlc.arg('action'), sqlc.arg('direction'), sqlc.arg('qty'),
  sqlc.arg('reference_price'), sqlc.narg('stop_price'), sqlc.narg('target_price'), sqlc.arg('reason'), sqlc.arg('policy'), sqlc.arg('status'), sqlc.arg('client_order_id'), sqlc.arg('profile_hash'), sqlc.narg('model_fill_price'), sqlc.narg('configuration_id'), sqlc.narg('position_cycle_id'), sqlc.narg('strategy_selection_id'),

cases.name: stonkpile/UpsertTradebotPosition
cases.sql:
-- name: UpsertTradebotPosition :exec
INSERT INTO tradebot_positions (
  scope_id, symbol, strategy, timeframe, direction, qty, avg_entry_price,
  stop_price, target_price, trail_price, entry_intent_id, entry_signal_id,
  entry_bar, last_signal_id, last_bar, configuration_id, position_cycle_id,
  strategy_selection_id, execution_policy
) VALUES (
  sqlc.arg('scope_id'), sqlc.arg('symbol'), sqlc.arg('strategy'), sqlc.arg('timeframe'), sqlc.arg('direction'), sqlc.arg('qty'), sqlc.arg('avg_entry_price'),
  sqlc.arg('stop_price'), sqlc.arg('target_price'), sqlc.arg('trail_price'), sqlc.arg('entry_intent_id'), sqlc.arg('entry_signal_id'),
  sqlc.arg('entry_bar'), sqlc.arg('last_signal_id'), sqlc.arg('last_bar'), sqlc.arg('configuration_id'), sqlc.arg('position_cycle_id'), sqlc.arg('strategy_selection_id'),
  COALESCE(sqlc.narg(execution_policy)::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb)
)
ON CONFLICT (scope_id, symbol) DO UPDATE SET
  strategy = EXCLUDED.strategy,
  timeframe = EXCLUDED.timeframe,
  direction = EXCLUDED.direction,
  qty = EXCLUDED.qty,
  avg_entry_price = EXCLUDED.avg_entry_price,
  stop_price = EXCLUDED.stop_price,
  target_price = EXCLUDED.target_price,
  trail_price = EXCLUDED.trail_price,
  entry_intent_id = EXCLUDED.entry_intent_id,
  entry_signal_id = EXCLUDED.entry_signal_id,
  entry_bar = EXCLUDED.entry_bar,
  last_signal_id = EXCLUDED.last_signal_id,
  last_bar = EXCLUDED.last_bar,
  configuration_id = EXCLUDED.configuration_id,
  position_cycle_id = EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id,
  strategy_selection_id = EXCLUDED.strategy_selection_id,
  execution_policy = EXCLUDED.execution_policy,
  trailing_peak = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id
      OR tradebot_positions.direction IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.direction
      OR (EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id IS NULL AND (
        tradebot_positions.entry_intent_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.entry_intent_id
        OR tradebot_positions.entry_bar IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.entry_bar)) THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.trailing_peak END,
  initial_risk_per_share = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.initial_risk_per_share END,
  initial_target_price = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.initial_target_price END,
  favorable_peak = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.favorable_peak END,
  adaptive_profit_active = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN FALSE
    ELSE tradebot_positions.adaptive_profit_active END,
  adaptive_profit_stop = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.adaptive_profit_stop END,
  adaptive_state_bar = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.adaptive_state_bar END,
  updated_at = now();

cases.name: stonkpile/UpsertTradebotPositions
cases.sql:
-- name: UpsertTradebotPositions :exec
-- Reconcile the broker's complete open-position snapshot in one statement.
-- The JSON recordset preserves nullable ownership and policy fields while
-- avoiding one round trip per position.
INSERT INTO tradebot_positions (
  scope_id, symbol, strategy, timeframe, direction, qty, avg_entry_price,
  stop_price, target_price, trail_price, entry_intent_id, entry_signal_id,
  entry_bar, last_signal_id, last_bar, configuration_id, position_cycle_id,
  strategy_selection_id, execution_policy
)
SELECT
  p.scope_id, p.symbol, p.strategy, p.timeframe, p.direction, p.qty,
  p.avg_entry_price, p.stop_price, p.target_price, p.trail_price,
  p.entry_intent_id, p.entry_signal_id, p.entry_bar, p.last_signal_id,
  p.last_bar, p.configuration_id, p.position_cycle_id,
  p.strategy_selection_id, COALESCE(p.execution_policy, '{}'::jsonb)
FROM jsonb_to_recordset(sqlc.arg(positions)::jsonb) AS p(
  scope_id text,
  symbol text,
  strategy text,
  timeframe text,
  direction text,
  qty double precision,
  avg_entry_price double precision,
  stop_price double precision,
  target_price double precision,
  trail_price double precision,
  entry_intent_id text,
  entry_signal_id bigint,
  entry_bar timestamptz,
  last_signal_id bigint,
  last_bar timestamptz,
  configuration_id bigint,
  position_cycle_id text,
  strategy_selection_id bigint,
  execution_policy jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (scope_id, symbol) DO UPDATE SET
  strategy = EXCLUDED.strategy,
  timeframe = EXCLUDED.timeframe,
  direction = EXCLUDED.direction,
  qty = EXCLUDED.qty,
  avg_entry_price = EXCLUDED.avg_entry_price,
  stop_price = EXCLUDED.stop_price,
  target_price = EXCLUDED.target_price,
  trail_price = EXCLUDED.trail_price,
  entry_intent_id = EXCLUDED.entry_intent_id,
  entry_signal_id = EXCLUDED.entry_signal_id,
  entry_bar = EXCLUDED.entry_bar,
  last_signal_id = EXCLUDED.last_signal_id,
  last_bar = EXCLUDED.last_bar,
  configuration_id = EXCLUDED.configuration_id,
  position_cycle_id = EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id,
  strategy_selection_id = EXCLUDED.strategy_selection_id,
  execution_policy = EXCLUDED.execution_policy,
  trailing_peak = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id
      OR tradebot_positions.direction IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.direction
      OR (EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id IS NULL AND (
        tradebot_positions.entry_intent_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.entry_intent_id
        OR tradebot_positions.entry_bar IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.entry_bar)) THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.trailing_peak END,
  initial_risk_per_share = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.initial_risk_per_share END,
  initial_target_price = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.initial_target_price END,
  favorable_peak = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.favorable_peak END,
  adaptive_profit_active = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN FALSE
    ELSE tradebot_positions.adaptive_profit_active END,
  adaptive_profit_stop = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.adaptive_profit_stop END,
  adaptive_state_bar = CASE
    WHEN tradebot_positions.position_cycle_id IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.position_cycle_id THEN NULL
    ELSE tradebot_positions.adaptive_state_bar END,
  updated_at = now();

cases.name: stonkpile/ListTradebotFillNotifications
cases.sql:
-- name: ListTradebotFillNotifications :many
SELECT f.fill_id, f.symbol, f.action, f.qty, f.price, f.realized_pnl,
       f.gross_pnl, f.net_pnl, f.total_costs, f.cost_breakdown,
       f.pnl_complete, f.missing_costs, f.filled_at, f.position_cycle_id,
       i.strategy, i.asset_class, i.timeframe, i.reason, i.account_id,
       f.execution_policy, f.decision_price, f.decision_to_fill_slippage_bps,
       COALESCE(tax.estimated_tax, 0)::double precision AS estimated_tax,
       COALESCE(tax.tax_complete, false) AS tax_complete
FROM tradebot_fill_events f
JOIN tradebot_intents i ON i.intent_id = f.intent_id
LEFT JOIN tradebot_fill_notification_receipts receipt ON receipt.fill_id = f.fill_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT sum(liability_delta)::double precision AS estimated_tax,
         bool_and(complete) AS tax_complete
  FROM tax_liability_events
  WHERE (tradebot_fill_id = f.fill_id OR desk_fill_order_id = f.broker_order_id)
    AND event_type <> 'withdrawal'
) tax ON true
WHERE i.asset_class = sqlc.arg(asset_class)
  AND (sqlc.arg(timeframe)::text = '' OR i.timeframe = sqlc.arg(timeframe))
  AND (receipt.fill_id IS NULL OR receipt.status = 'unhandled')
ORDER BY f.filled_at, f.fill_id
LIMIT sqlc.arg(limit_count);

cases.name: stonkpile/AdvanceTradebotTrailingPeak
cases.sql:
-- name: AdvanceTradebotTrailingPeak :one
-- Row locking makes concurrent observations a monotone extremum. The complete
-- identity guard rejects delayed observations from a closed/replaced cycle.
UPDATE tradebot_positions
SET trailing_peak = CASE WHEN direction = 'short'
      THEN LEAST(COALESCE(trailing_peak, sqlc.arg(price)::double precision), sqlc.arg(price)::double precision)
      ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(trailing_peak, sqlc.arg(price)::double precision), sqlc.arg(price)::double precision) END,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE scope_id = sqlc.arg(scope_id) AND symbol = sqlc.arg(symbol)
  AND position_cycle_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM sqlc.narg(position_cycle_id)::text
  AND (position_cycle_id IS NOT NULL OR (
    entry_intent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM sqlc.narg(entry_intent_id)::text
    AND entry_bar IS NOT DISTINCT FROM sqlc.narg(entry_bar)::timestamptz))
  AND direction = sqlc.arg(direction)
RETURNING trailing_peak;

cases.name: stonkpile/AdvanceTradebotTrailingPeaks
cases.sql:
-- name: AdvanceTradebotTrailingPeaks :many
-- Preserve the single-observation identity guard and row-locked extremum.
WITH observations AS (
  SELECT o->>'scope_id' AS scope_id, o->>'symbol' AS symbol,
         o->>'position_cycle_id' AS position_cycle_id,
         o->>'entry_intent_id' AS entry_intent_id,
         (o->>'entry_bar')::timestamptz AS entry_bar,
         o->>'direction' AS direction, (o->>'price')::double precision AS price
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(sqlc.arg(observations)::jsonb) AS o
)
UPDATE tradebot_positions p
SET trailing_peak = CASE WHEN p.direction = 'short'
      THEN LEAST(COALESCE(p.trailing_peak, o.price), o.price)
      ELSE GREATEST(COALESCE(p.trailing_peak, o.price), o.price) END,
    updated_at = now()
FROM observations o
WHERE p.scope_id = o.scope_id AND p.symbol = o.symbol
  AND p.position_cycle_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.position_cycle_id
  AND (p.position_cycle_id IS NOT NULL OR (
    p.entry_intent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.entry_intent_id
    AND p.entry_bar IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.entry_bar))
  AND p.direction = o.direction
RETURNING p.scope_id, p.symbol, p.trailing_peak;

cases.name: stonkpile/AdoptTradebotProtectiveOrderLinks

-- name: AdoptTradebotProtectiveOrderLinks :one
WITH links AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT supplied.scope_id::text AS scope_id, supplied.symbol::text AS symbol,
           supplied.target_order_id::text AS target_order_id, supplied.stop_order_id::text AS stop_order_id
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset(sqlc.arg(order_links)::jsonb)
      AS supplied(scope_id text, symbol text, target_order_id text, stop_order_id text)
), targets AS (
    UPDATE tradebot_positions AS p
    SET target_order_id = links.target_order_id,
        target_order_updated_at = now(), updated_at = now()
    FROM links
    WHERE p.scope_id = links.scope_id AND p.symbol = links.symbol
      AND p.target_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM links.target_order_id
    RETURNING 1
), lots AS (
    UPDATE tradebot_inventory_lots AS lot
    SET protection_order_id = links.stop_order_id,
        target_order_id = links.target_order_id,
        revision = lot.revision + 1, updated_at = now()
    FROM links
    WHERE lot.scope_id = links.scope_id AND lot.symbol = links.symbol
      AND lot.status IN ('open', 'closing') AND lot.remaining_qty > 0
      AND links.stop_order_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (lot.protection_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM links.stop_order_id
           OR lot.target_order_id IS DISTINCT FROM links.target_order_id)
    RETURNING 1
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM targets) + (SELECT count(*) FROM lots) AS updated_rows;

cases.name: stonkpile/GetTradebotInventoryCycleBalance
cases.sql:
-- name: GetTradebotInventoryCycleBalance :one
-- Only original durable fills can prove a prior lifecycle is fully closed.
WITH owner AS (
 SELECT e.scope_id,e.symbol,COALESCE(NULLIF(e.position_cycle_id,''),e.intent_id) AS cycle_id
 FROM tradebot_intents e
 WHERE e.intent_id=sqlc.arg(entry_intent_id) AND e.scope_id=sqlc.arg(scope_id)
   AND e.symbol=sqlc.arg(symbol) AND e.action IN ('open_long','open_short')
)
SELECT
 COALESCE((SELECT sum(f.qty) FROM tradebot_fill_events f
   JOIN tradebot_intents i ON i.intent_id=f.intent_id
   WHERE f.scope_id=o.scope_id AND f.symbol=o.symbol
     AND f.action IN ('open_long','open_short')
     AND COALESCE(NULLIF(i.position_cycle_id,''),i.intent_id)=o.cycle_id),0)::double precision AS entry_qty,
 COALESCE((SELECT sum(f.qty) FROM tradebot_fill_events f
   WHERE f.scope_id=o.scope_id AND f.symbol=o.symbol
     AND f.action IN ('close_long','cover_short')
     AND f.position_cycle_id=o.cycle_id),0)::double precision AS closed_qty
FROM owner o;

cases.name: stonkpile/ClaimPendingMissedBacktestTrades
cases.sql:
-- name: ClaimPendingMissedBacktestTrades :many
WITH claimed AS (
 UPDATE tradebot_missed_backtest_trades
 SET notification_claimed_at = now()
 WHERE id IN (
  SELECT p.id FROM tradebot_missed_backtest_trades p
  WHERE p.account_id = sqlc.arg('account_id') AND p.asset_class = sqlc.arg('asset_class') AND p.timeframe = sqlc.arg('timeframe')
   AND NOT p.notified AND p.notification_claimed_at IS NULL
   AND p.id = ANY(sqlc.arg(eligible_ids)::bigint[])
   -- Replay can outlive the intent read that nominated these candidates.
   -- An admitted order is broker-state divergence, never a missed action.
   AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM tradebot_intents i
    WHERE i.account_id = p.account_id AND i.asset_class = p.asset_class
     AND i.timeframe = p.timeframe AND i.strategy = p.strategy
     AND i.symbol = p.symbol AND i.direction = p.direction
     AND i.action IN ('open_long', 'open_short')
     AND i.decision_bar = p.backtest_entry_time - sqlc.arg(bar_seconds)::double precision * interval '1 second'
   )
  ORDER BY p.backtest_entry_time, p.symbol, p.direction
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
 )
 RETURNING *
)
SELECT * FROM claimed ORDER BY backtest_entry_time, symbol, direction;

cases.sql:
-- name: ListTradebotParityFills :many
SELECT f.fill_id, i.asset_class, i.timeframe, i.reason, owner.decision_bar, f.symbol,
  owner.direction, owner.action, f.action, f.qty,
  COALESCE(f.initial_entry_price, f.price) AS entry_price, f.price AS exit_price,
  COALESCE(f.initial_entry_filled_at, owner.decision_bar) AS entry_at,
  f.filled_at AS exit_at, f.net_pnl, c.identity, e.result,
  owner.profile_hash, p.execution_profile,
  COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(p.universe), 0)::integer AS symbol_count,
  owner.intent_id, owner.qty::float8 AS requested_qty,
  COALESCE(owner.stop_price, 0)::float8 AS stop_price,
  COALESCE(owner.target_price, 0)::float8 AS target_price,
  COALESCE(p.snapshot_id, '')::text AS snapshot_id,
  COALESCE(p.policy_context->'signalEvaluation'->>'version', '') = '1' AS strict_decision,
  owner.reference_price::float8 AS reference_price,
  x.identity AS exit_identity, x.inputs AS exit_inputs,
  i.intent_id AS exit_intent_id, i.qty::float8 AS exit_qty,
  i.decision_bar AS exit_decision_bar, i.reference_price::float8 AS exit_reference_price, f.broker_order_id,
  COALESCE(f.position_cycle_id, i.position_cycle_id, '')::text AS position_cycle_id
FROM tradebot_fill_events f
JOIN tradebot_intents i ON i.intent_id = f.intent_id
JOIN tradebot_intents owner ON owner.intent_id = CASE
  WHEN f.action LIKE 'open%' THEN i.intent_id ELSE COALESCE(f.position_cycle_id, i.position_cycle_id) END
  AND owner.account_id = i.account_id AND owner.broker = i.broker
  AND owner.asset_class = i.asset_class AND owner.timeframe = i.timeframe
JOIN signals s ON s.id = owner.signal_id
JOIN LATERAL (SELECT identity, evaluation_hash FROM tradebot_parity_contracts c
  WHERE c.asset_class = i.asset_class AND c.timeframe = i.timeframe AND c.watermark = owner.decision_bar
  AND c.strategy_config_hash = s.strategy_config_hash AND c.portfolio_hash = s.portfolio_hash
  AND c.strategy_version = s.strategy_evaluation_version
  AND c.created_at <= owner.created_at
  ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT snapshot_id, execution_profile, universe, policy_context FROM tradebot_parity_snapshots p
  WHERE p.account_id = owner.account_id AND p.broker = owner.broker
  AND p.asset_class = owner.asset_class AND p.timeframe = owner.timeframe AND p.watermark = owner.decision_bar
  AND p.profile_hash = c.identity->>'profileHash' AND p.portfolio_hash = s.portfolio_hash
  AND p.strategy_config_hash = s.strategy_config_hash AND p.strategy_evaluation_version = s.strategy_evaluation_version
  AND p.created_at <= owner.created_at ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) p ON true
LEFT JOIN tradebot_parity_exit_evaluations x
  ON x.intent_id = i.intent_id AND f.action NOT LIKE 'open%'
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT result, matched FROM tradebot_backtest_parity_evidence e
  WHERE e.fill_id = f.fill_id
    AND e.evaluation_hash = COALESCE(x.identity->>'hash', c.evaluation_hash)
  ORDER BY (report_id LIKE 'protection-execution:%' OR report_id LIKE 'batch:%') DESC,
    CASE WHEN report_id LIKE 'protection-execution:%' OR report_id LIKE 'batch:%'
      THEN COALESCE((result->>'engineVersion')::integer, 0) ELSE 0 END DESC,
    (report_id LIKE 'protection-execution:%') DESC,
    matched DESC, checked_at DESC, report_id
  LIMIT 1) e ON true
WHERE i.mode IN ('canonical', 'exit_only', 'manage_only')
  AND (cardinality(sqlc.arg('fill_ids')::text[]) = 0 OR f.fill_id = ANY(sqlc.arg('fill_ids')::text[]))
  AND (NOT sqlc.arg('pending_only')::boolean OR COALESCE(e.matched, false) = false OR e.result->>'reportId' LIKE 'protection:%')
ORDER BY f.filled_at DESC, f.fill_id
LIMIT 5000;

cases.name: stonkpile/ListParityClosingCohortFillIDs
cases.sql:
-- name: ListParityClosingCohortFillIDs :many
-- Select the requested accounts/days before the expensive lineage joins.
-- Include completed and leased partials: job state must not change a replay.
SELECT DISTINCT f.fill_id
FROM tradebot_fill_events f
JOIN tradebot_intents i ON i.intent_id=f.intent_id
JOIN tradebot_parity_snapshots p
  ON p.snapshot_id=ANY(sqlc.arg(snapshot_ids)::text[])
 AND i.account_id=p.account_id AND i.broker=p.broker
 AND i.asset_class=p.asset_class AND i.timeframe=p.timeframe
WHERE f.action IN ('close_long','close_short','cover_short')
  AND f.filled_at>=sqlc.arg(from_at)::timestamptz
  AND f.filled_at<sqlc.arg(through_at)::timestamptz
ORDER BY f.fill_id;

cases.name: stonkpile/ListPendingParityOrders
cases.sql:
-- name: ListPendingParityOrders :many
SELECT i.intent_id, i.asset_class, i.timeframe, i.reason, i.decision_bar,
       i.symbol, i.direction, i.qty::float8 AS requested_qty,
       COALESCE(i.stop_price, 0)::float8 AS stop_price,
       COALESCE(i.target_price, 0)::float8 AS target_price,
       c.identity, p.snapshot_id, i.reference_price::float8 AS reference_price,
       i.profile_hash, p.execution_profile,
       COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(p.universe), 0)::integer AS symbol_count,
       COALESCE(p.policy_context->'signalEvaluation'->>'version', '') = '1' AS strict_decision
FROM tradebot_intents i
JOIN signals s ON s.id = i.signal_id
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT identity, evaluation_hash
    FROM tradebot_parity_contracts c
    WHERE c.asset_class = i.asset_class AND c.timeframe = i.timeframe
      AND c.watermark = i.decision_bar
      AND c.strategy_config_hash = s.strategy_config_hash
      AND c.portfolio_hash = s.portfolio_hash
      AND c.strategy_version = s.strategy_evaluation_version
      AND c.created_at <= i.created_at
    ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
) c ON true
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT snapshot_id, execution_profile, universe, policy_context
    FROM tradebot_parity_snapshots p
    WHERE p.account_id = i.account_id AND p.broker = i.broker
      AND p.asset_class = i.asset_class AND p.timeframe = i.timeframe
      AND p.watermark = i.decision_bar
      AND p.profile_hash = c.identity->>'profileHash'
      AND p.strategy_config_hash = s.strategy_config_hash
      AND p.portfolio_hash = s.portfolio_hash
      AND p.created_at <= i.created_at
    ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
) p ON true
LEFT JOIN tradebot_parity_order_decisions d
  ON d.intent_id = i.intent_id AND d.evaluation_hash = c.evaluation_hash
WHERE i.mode = 'canonical'
  AND i.action IN ('open_long', 'open_short')
  AND i.broker_order_id IS NOT NULL AND i.broker_order_id <> ''
  AND d.intent_id IS NULL
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
LIMIT 100;

cases.name: stonkpile/GetOrCreateTradebotReplayAnchor
cases.sql:
-- name: GetOrCreateTradebotReplayAnchor :one
INSERT INTO tradebot_replay_anchors (
  lineage_key, asset_class, timeframe, profile_hash, strategy_config,
  direction_overlay, universe, replay_from, first_watermark
) VALUES (
  sqlc.arg('lineage_key'), sqlc.arg('asset_class'), sqlc.arg('timeframe'),
  sqlc.arg('profile_hash'), sqlc.arg('strategy_config')::jsonb,
  sqlc.arg('direction_overlay'), sqlc.arg('universe')::jsonb,
  COALESCE(
    -- Existing immutable anchors must not rescan snapshot history on every
    -- decision. Keep the conflict handler for concurrent first-time creators.
    (
      SELECT existing.replay_from
      FROM tradebot_replay_anchors AS existing
      WHERE existing.lineage_key = sqlc.arg('lineage_key')
    ),
    (
      SELECT existing.replay_from
      FROM tradebot_replay_anchors AS existing
      WHERE existing.lineage_key = sqlc.arg('legacy_lineage_key')
    ),
    (
      SELECT date_trunc('day', min(watermark) - interval '3 months')
      FROM tradebot_parity_snapshots
      WHERE asset_class = sqlc.arg('asset_class')
        AND timeframe = sqlc.arg('timeframe')
        AND profile_hash = sqlc.arg('profile_hash')
        AND strategy_config = sqlc.arg('strategy_config')::jsonb
        AND universe = sqlc.arg('universe')::jsonb
        AND watermark <= sqlc.arg('watermark')::timestamptz
    ),
    date_trunc('day', sqlc.arg('watermark')::timestamptz - interval '3 months')
  ),
  sqlc.arg('watermark')
)
ON CONFLICT (lineage_key) DO UPDATE
SET lineage_key = EXCLUDED.lineage_key
RETURNING lineage_key, replay_from, seeded_through;

-- name: ListTradebotFillsForAccount :many
SELECT

    COALESCE(f.initial_entry_filled_at, i.decision_bar) AS initial_entry_filled_at,
    f.realized_pnl,

    f.net_pnl,

    f.cost_breakdown,
    f.pnl_complete,
    f.missing_costs,
    i.account_id,
    i.broker,

    i.signal_id,
    i.direction,
    i.reason,
    s.ts AS signal_ts,
    s.created_at AS signal_created_at,
    s.direction AS signal_direction,
    s.conviction AS signal_conviction,
    s.entry AS signal_entry,
    s.stop AS signal_stop,
    s.target AS signal_target,

FROM tradebot_fill_events f
JOIN tradebot_intents i ON i.intent_id = f.intent_id
LEFT JOIN signals s ON s.id = i.signal_id

WHERE i.broker = sqlc.arg(broker)

  AND i.asset_class = sqlc.arg(asset_class)

  AND (sqlc.narg(filled_to)::timestamptz IS NULL OR f.filled_at <= sqlc.narg(filled_to))

-- Partition by counter epoch so restarts cannot create a negative delta.
-- Keep the sample before the window; the first sample in each epoch has no known delta.
WITH scope AS (SELECT CAST(epoch(CAST(current_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) * 1000000000 AS BIGINT) - greatest(1, least(CAST($window_minutes AS BIGINT), 180)) * 60000000000 AS since_ns, ((greatest(1, least(CAST($window_minutes AS BIGINT), 180)) + 23) // 24) * 60000000000 AS bucket_ns), samples AS (
  SELECT timestamp_ns, attributes, value,
    lag(value) OVER (PARTITION BY series_key, start_timestamp_ns ORDER BY timestamp_ns) AS previous
  FROM metrics WHERE service_name = $service AND session_id = $session_id AND name = 'spaniel.ingest.metrics_points'
    AND json_extract_string(attributes, '$.result') = 'accepted'
)
SELECT (timestamp_ns // bucket_ns) * bucket_ns AS timestamp_ns,
  sum(greatest(value - previous, 0)) AS value,
  json_extract_string(attributes, '$.signal') AS group_value
FROM samples CROSS JOIN scope WHERE timestamp_ns >= since_ns AND previous IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 1, 3 LIMIT 128
